title_en: Collapsed Effective Operators for Higher-order Structures
title_zh: 用于高阶结构的折叠有效算子

sentences.en: Higher-order structures are powerful relational modeling tools, yet existing spectral operators decompose topology into separate ranks, leaving practitioners to fuse information back to vertices through ad-hoc choices.
sentences.zh: 高阶结构是强大的关系建模工具，然而现有的谱算子将拓扑分解为分离的秩，使从业者不得不通过临时选择将信息融合回顶点。

sentences.en: We introduce _Collapsed Effective Operators_, which condense higher-order degrees of freedom into a single vertex-level operator via Schur complementation of a graded Laplacian.
sentences.zh: 我们引入_坍缩有效算子_，它通过对一个分级的 Laplacian 进行 Schur 补计算，将高阶自由度凝聚为单一顶点级算子。

sentences.en: This yields a (generally dense) operator that encodes long-range interactions mediated by topology and is applicable to arbitrary higher-order constructs.
sentences.zh: 这产生一个（通常是稠密的）算子，它编码由拓扑介导的长程交互，并适用于任意高阶构造。

sentences.en: We show it preserves positive semi-definiteness with a strict spectral upper bound relative to the rank-0 Hodge Laplacian, effectively lowering system energy under higher-order connectivity.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，它相对于秩 0 的 Hodge Laplacian 保持半正定性并具有严格的谱上界，从而在高阶连通性下有效地降低系统能量。

sentences.en: Empirically, our operator improves spectral clustering, signal smoothing and enables the inclusion of topological features in neural network architectures via positional encoding.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们的算子改进了谱聚类、信号平滑，并能够通过位置编码将拓扑特征纳入神经网络架构。

title_en: COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space
title_zh: COLLIE：在语义一致的潜在空间中引导技能发现

sentences.en: Unsupervised skill discovery (USD) aims to learn diverse behaviors without reward functions, but often results in task-irrelevant or hazardous behaviors due to uniform exploration.
sentences.zh: 无监督技能发现（USD）旨在无需奖励函数地学习多样行为，但由于均匀探索，往往会得到与任务无关或危险的行为。

sentences.en: Guided skill discovery (GSD) addresses this issue by incorporating human intent to focus exploration on meaningful regions.
sentences.zh: 引导式技能发现（GSD）通过纳入人类意图，将探索聚焦到有意义的区域来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: However, existing GSD methods typically require training additional guidance models, and rely on pre-defined rules or expert demonstration, which can be ineffective under sparse, online-collected human feedback.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 GSD 方法通常需要训练额外的引导模型，并依赖预定义的规则或专家演示，而这些在稀疏、在线收集的人类反馈下可能低效。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose COLLIE, a GSD framework that leverages dense unsupervised data to construct a semantically coherent skill latent space.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一不足，我们提出 COLLIE，一个利用稠密无监督数据构建语义连贯技能潜在空间的 GSD 框架。

sentences.en: This latent space is well-structured, enabling reliable guidance with sparse online feedback.
sentences.zh: 该潜在空间结构良好，能够在稀疏在线反馈下提供可靠的引导。

sentences.en: Moreover, its semantic coherence property enables training-free construction of guidance signals, eliminating the need for additional model training beyond skill learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，其语义连贯性使得无需训练即可构建引导信号，从而消除了在技能学习之外进行额外模型训练的需要。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis justifies the effectiveness of our training-free guidance signal, while experiments across diverse state-based and pixel-based tasks show that COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills, avoids hazardous behaviors, and achieves superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.
sentences.zh: 理论分析验证了我们免训练引导信号的有效性，而跨多样状态与像素任务中的实验表明，COLLIE 能以最少的人类反馈学习到多样、与人类对齐的技能，避免危险行为，并取得优越的下游性能。

title_en: Colorful Pinball: Density-Weighted Quantile Regression for Conditional Guarantee of Conformal Prediction
title_zh: 多彩弹球：通过密度加权分位数回归实现共形预测的条件保证

sentences.en: Although conformal prediction provides robust marginal coverage guarantees, achieving reliable conditional coverage for specific inputs remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然保形预测提供了稳健的边际覆盖保证，但对特定输入实现可靠的条件覆盖仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: While exact distribution-free conditional coverage is impossible with finite samples, recent work has focused on improving the conditional coverage of standard conformal procedures.
sentences.zh: 虽然利用有限样本实现精确的无分布条件覆盖是不可能的，但近期工作聚焦于改进标准保形流程的条件覆盖。

sentences.en: Distinct from approaches that target relaxed notions of conditional coverage, we directly target the mean squared error of conditional coverage by refining the quantile regression components that underpin many conformal methods.
sentences.zh: 与瞄准条件覆盖的松弛概念的方法不同，我们通过精炼支撑许多保形方法的量化回归分量，直接以条件覆盖的均方误差为目标。

sentences.en: Leveraging a Taylor expansion, we derive a sharp surrogate objective for quantile regression: a density-weighted pinball loss, where the weights are given by the conditional density of the nonconformity score evaluated at the true quantile.
sentences.zh: 利用 Taylor 展开，我们为一个量化回归推导出一个精确的替代目标：一个密度加权的弹球损失，其中权重由在真实分位数处评估的不符合分数的条件密度给出。

sentences.en: We propose a three-headed quantile network that estimates these weights via finite differences using auxiliary quantile levels at $1-\alpha \pm \delta$, subsequently fine-tuning the central quantile by optimizing the weighted loss.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个三头分位数网络，它利用辅助分位数水平在 1–α ± δ 处通过有限差分估计这些权重，随后通过优化加权损失来微调中心分位数。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis with exact non-asymptotic guarantees characterizing the resulting excess risk.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了带有精确非渐近保证的理论分析，刻画了由此产生的超额的额外风险。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on diverse high-dimensional real-world datasets demonstrate remarkable improvements in conditional coverage performance.
sentences.zh: 在多样高维真实世界数据集上的大量实验证明了条件覆盖性能的显著改进。

sentences.en: We release the code at \url{https://github.com/Cqyiiii/Colorful-Pinball-Conformal-Prediction-CPCP}.
sentences.zh: 我们在 \url{https://github.com/Cqyiiii/Colorful-Pinball-Conformal-Prediction-CPCP} 发布了代码。

title_en: Coloring the Noise: Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for Faithful Image Super Resolution
title_zh: 为噪声着色：通过对抗 Sobolev 对齐实现忠实图像超分辨率

sentences.en: Generative priors in Image Super-Resolution (SR) often compromise faithful restoration, we attribute this limitation to a fundamental spectral misalignment between isotropic objectives and the intrinsic natural image manifold.
sentences.zh: 图像超分辨率（SR）中的生成先验常常损害忠实的恢复，我们将这一局限归因于各向同性目标与内在自然图像流形之间的根本性谱失配。

sentences.en: While Direct Preference Optimization offers a path to alignment, its reliance on spectrally flat Gaussian noise fails to distinguish authentic high-frequency details from hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 虽然直接偏好优化提供了一条对齐之路，但它对谱平坦高斯噪声的依赖无法区分真正的高频细节与幻觉。

sentences.en: To bridge this geometric gap, we propose ASASR, a theoretically grounded framework that recasts the generative flow into a Sobolev-induced Riemannian geometry by explicitly coloring the noise transition kernel to mirror natural spectral decay.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一几何差距，我们提出 ASASR，一个在理论上扎实的框架，它通过显式地对噪声转移核着色以镜像自然的谱衰减，将生成流重构为 Sobolev 诱导的黎曼几何。

sentences.en: Driving this geometric alignment, we integrate a parametric adversary grounded in the Riesz Representation Theorem, which synthesizes targeted negative samples equivalent to worst-case Sobolev gradients to direct optimization along the tangent space of plausible structural failures.
sentences.zh: 为推动这一几何对齐，我们整合了一个以 Riesz 表示定理为基础的参数化对手，它合成等同于最坏情况 Sobolev 梯度的针对性负样本，以沿着可能结构失效的切空间引导优化。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ASASR outperforms leading generative baselines, particularly in preserving spectral consistency and structural fidelity, offering a robust solution that effectively mitigates artifacts.
sentences.zh: 大量评估表明，ASASR 优于领先的生成基线，尤其是在保持谱一致性与结构保真度方面，提供了一种有效缓解伪影的稳健解决方案。

title_en: Column Thresholding for Sparse Spiked Wigner Models: Improved Signal Strength Requirements
title_zh: 稀疏尖峰 Wigner 模型的列阈值化：降低信号强度要求

sentences.en: We study the sparse spiked Wigner model, where the goal is to recover an $s$-sparse unit vector $\boldsymbol{u} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ from a noisy observation $\boldsymbol{Y} = \beta \boldsymbol{u} \boldsymbol{u}^\top + \boldsymbol{W}$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究稀疏尖峰 Wigner 模型，其目标是从带噪观测 Y=Beta uu 转置 + W 中恢复一个 s 稀疏的单位向量 u。

sentences.en: While the information-theoretic threshold is $\beta = \widetilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{s})$, existing polynomial-time algorithms require $\beta = \widetilde{\Omega}(s)$, yielding a substantial computational-statistical gap.
sentences.zh: 虽然信息论阈值为 Beta=Omega(sqrt(s))，现有的多项式时间算法需要 Beta=Omega(s)，从而产生了可观的计算-统计差距。

sentences.en: We propose a column thresholding method that attains the $\widetilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{s})$ scaling for both estimation and support recovery under the non-uniformity condition $|| \boldsymbol{u} ||_\infty = \Omega(1)$.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种列阈值化方法，在非均匀性条件 ||u||_inf=Omega(1) 下，对估计与支持恢复两者都达到 Omega(sqrt(s)) 的缩放。

sentences.en: This condition is not merely technical: it explicitly rules out uniform spikes, for which planted-clique-based hardness results apply, and identifies a concrete class of non-uniform spikes where the required signal strength can be reduced.
sentences.zh: 这一条件并非仅仅是技术性的：它显式地排除了均匀尖峰（对此适用基于种植团簇的困难结果），并识别出一类具体的非均匀尖峰，其中所需的信号强度可以降低。

sentences.en: Building on this initializer, we further develop a truncated power method that iteratively refines the estimate with provable linear convergence.
sentences.zh: 在这一初始化器的基础上，我们进一步开发了一个截断幂方法，以可证明的线性收敛迭代地精炼估计。

title_en: CombinationTS: A Modular Framework for Understanding Time-Series Forecasting Models
title_zh: CombinationTS：用于理解时间序列预测模型的模块化框架

sentences.en: Recent progress in time-series forecasting has led to rapidly increasing architectural complexity, yet many reported State-of-the-Art gains are statistically fragile or misattributed.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测的近期进展导致架构复杂性迅速增加，然而许多已报道的最先进收益在统计上是脆弱的或被错误归因。

sentences.en: We argue that progress requires a shift from model selection to modular attribution, identifying which components truly drive performance.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，进展需要从模型选择转向模块化归因，识别出哪些组件真正驱动性能。

sentences.en: We propose CombinationTS, a self-contained probabilistic evaluation framework grounded in Evaluatology, the science of uncovering the effects.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CombinationTS，一个以评估学（Evaluatology），即揭示效应的科学，为基础的自包含概率评估框架。

sentences.en: It decomposes forecasting models into orthogonal modules—Input Transformation, Embedding, Encoder, Decoder, and Output Transformation—and evaluates them under a shared evaluation condition space.
sentences.zh: 它将预测模型分解为正交的模块——输入变换、嵌入、编码器、解码器与输出变换——并在一个共享的评估条件空间下对它们进行评估。

sentences.en: By quantifying each component via marginalized performance ($\mu$) and stability ($\sigma$), CombinationTS enables robust attribution beyond fragile point estimates.
sentences.zh: 通过以边际化性能（mu）与稳定性（sigma）量化每个组件，CombinationTS 实现了超越脆弱点估计的稳健归因。

sentences.en: Through large-scale paired evaluation, we uncover the Identity Paradox: once the data view (Embedding) is well-designed, a parameter-free Identity Encoder often matches or outperforms complex backbones.
sentences.zh: 通过大规模配对评估，我们揭示了恒等悖论：一旦数据视图（嵌入）得到良好设计，一个无参数的恒等编码器常常匹敌甚至超越复杂的骨干网络。

title_en: Combinatorial Sparse PCA Beyond the Spiked Identity Model
title_zh: 超越尖峰单位矩阵模型的组合稀疏主成分分析

sentences.en: Sparse PCA is one of the most well-studied problems in high-dimensional statistics.
sentences.zh: 稀疏 PCA 是高维统计中研究最充分的问题之一。

sentences.en: In this problem, we are given samples from a distribution with covariance $\\mathbf{\Sigma}$, whose top eigenvector $\\mathbf{v} \in \\mathbb{R}^d$ is $s$-sparse.
sentences.zh: 在此问题中，我们给定来自一个协方差为 Sigma 的分布的样本，其最大特征向量 v 是 s 稀疏的。

sentences.en: Existing sparse PCA algorithms can be broadly categorized into (1) combinatorial algorithms (e.g., diagonal or elementwise covariance thresholding) and (2) SDP-based algorithms.
sentences.zh: 现有的稀疏 PCA 算法可以大致分为（1）组合算法（例如对角或逐元素协方差阈值化）与（2）基于 SDP 的算法。

sentences.en: While combinatorial algorithms are much simpler, they are typically only analyzed under the spiked identity model (where $\\mathbf{\Sigma} \propto \\mathbf{I}_d + \gamma \\mathbf{v}\\mathbf{v}^\top$ for some $\gamma > 0$), whereas SDP-based algorithms require no additional assumptions on $\\mathbf{\Sigma}$.
sentences.zh: 虽然组合算法简单得多，但它们通常只在尖峰恒等模型（其中 Sigma 与 I_d + gamma v v 转置 成比例，对某 gamma>0）下被分析，而基于 SDP 的算法则对 Sigma 无需额外假设。

sentences.en: We demonstrate explicit counterexample covariances $\\mathbf{\Sigma}$ against the success of standard combinatorial algorithms for sparse PCA, when moving beyond the spiked identity model.
sentences.zh: 我们演示了在超越尖峰恒等模型时，针对标准组合稀疏 PCA 算法成功性的显式反例协方差 Sigma。

sentences.en: In light of this discrepancy, we give the first combinatorial method for sparse PCA that provably succeeds for general $\\mathbf{\Sigma}$ using $\\mathsf{poly}(s, \log(d))$ samples and $d^2 \cdot \\mathsf{poly}(s, \log(d))$ time, by providing a global convergence guarantee on the truncated power method of Yuan and Zhang (JMLR, 2013).
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一差异，我们给出第一个可证明对一般 Sigma 有效的组合稀疏 PCA 方法，它使用 poly(s, log(d)) 个样本与 d^2 · poly(s, log(d)) 时间，通过为 Yuan 与 Zhang（JMLR, 2013）的截断幂方法提供全局收敛保证而实现。

sentences.en: We provide a natural generalization of our method to recovering $k$ sparse principal components.
sentences.zh: 我们将方法自然推广到恢复 k 个稀疏主成分。

sentences.en: Finally, we evaluate our method on synthetic and real-world sparse PCA datasets.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在合成与真实世界的稀疏 PCA 数据集上评估了我们的方法。

title_en: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
title_zh: CoME：以信息丰富的混合能力推理增强移动专家通道

sentences.en: Mobile Agents requires hybrid-capabilities reasoning, including screen summary, subtask planning, action decision and action function.
sentences.zh: 移动智能体需要混合能力推理，包括屏幕摘要、子任务规划、动作决策与动作函数。

sentences.en: However, existing agents struggle to achieve both decoupled enhancement and balanced integration of these capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有智能体难以同时实现这些能力的解耦增强与均衡整合。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Channel-of-Mobile-Experts (CoME), a novel agent architecture consisting of four distinct experts, each aligned with a specific reasoning stage, CoME activates the corresponding expert to generate output tokens in each reasoning stage via output-oriented activation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出移动专家通道（Channel-of-Mobile-Experts，CoME），一种新颖的智能体架构，由四个与特定推理阶段对齐的独立专家组成，CoME 通过面向输出的激活，在每个推理阶段激活相应的专家来生成输出词元。

sentences.en: To empower CoME with hybrid-capabilities reasoning, we introduce a progressive training strategy: Expert-FT enables decoupling and enhancement of different experts’ capability;
sentences.zh: 为赋予 CoME 混合能力推理，我们引入一种渐进式训练策略：Expert-FT 实现不同专家能力的解耦与增强；

sentences.en: Router-FT aligns expert activation with the different reasoning stage;
sentences.zh: Router-FT 使专家激活与不同推理阶段对齐；

sentences.en: CoT-FT facilitates seamless collaboration and balanced optimization across multiple capabilities.
sentences.zh: CoT-FT 促进多种能力之间的无缝协作与均衡优化。

sentences.en: To mitigate error propagation in hybrid-capabilities reasoning, we propose InfoGain-Driven DPO (Info-DPO), which uses information gain to evaluate the contribution of each intermediate step, thereby guiding CoME toward more informative reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为缓解混合能力推理中的误差传播，我们提出 InfoGain 驱动的 DPO（Info-DPO），它使用信息增益来评估每个中间步的贡献，从而引导 CoME 走向更具信息量的推理。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments show that CoME outperforms dense mobile agents and MoE methods on both AITZ and AMEX datasets.
sentences.zh: 全面实验表明，CoME 在 AITZ 与 AMEX 数据集上都优于稠密移动智能体与 MoE 方法。

title_en: CoMem: Context Management with A Decoupled Long-Context Model
title_zh: CoMem：利用解耦长上下文模型进行上下文管理

sentences.en: Context management enables agentic models to solve long-horizon tasks through iterative summarization of previous interaction histories.
sentences.zh: 上下文管理使智能体模型能够通过迭代总结先前的交互历史来解决长时序任务。

sentences.en: However, this process typically incurs substantial decoding overhead for the extra summarization tokens, which significantly affect the end-to-end response latency at deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一过程通常会为额外的总结词元产生大量的解码开销，显著影响部署时的端到端响应延迟。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce CoMem, a novel framework that decouples memory management from the primary agent workflow, enabling these processes to execute in parallel.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 CoMem，一个新颖的框架，它把记忆管理与主要智能体工作流解耦，使这些过程能够并行执行。

sentences.en: We propose a $k$-step-off asynchronous pipeline that overlaps the memory model's summarization with the agent's inference, effectively masking the latency of context processing.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个 $k$-步偏移的异步流水线，它使记忆模型的总结与智能体的推理重叠，有效地掩盖了上下文处理的延迟。

sentences.en: To ensure robustness under this asynchronous setting, we introduce a reward-driven training strategy that aligns the memory model to capture sufficient statistics for the agent's decision-making.
sentences.zh: 为确保这一异步设定下的稳健性，我们引入一种奖励驱动的训练策略，使记忆模型对齐以捕获足够用于智能体决策的统计量。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis confirms that CoMem offers a superior efficiency-effectiveness trade-off compared to coupled architectures.
sentences.zh: 理论分析证实，与耦合架构相比，CoMem 提供了更优的效率-有效性权衡。

sentences.en: Our extensive experimental results on SWE-Bench-Verified show that CoMem provides 1.4x latency improvements upon vanilla long-context solutions while preserving most of the performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上的大量实验结果表明，CoMem 在保留大部分性能的同时，比香草长上下文解决方案提供了 1.4 倍的延迟改进。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate that these latency gains scale favorably with increased system throughput, offering a modular path forward for the independent optimization of agent reasoning and memory compression.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明这些延迟收益随系统吞吐量的增加而有利地扩展，为智能体推理与记忆压缩的独立优化提供了一条模块化路径。

title_en: Commit to the Bit: Reactive Reinforcement Learning Done Right
title_zh: Commit to the Bit：正确实现反应式强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning algorithms are commonly analyzed (and designed) under the Markov assumption.
sentences.zh: 强化学习算法通常在马尔可夫假设下被分析（与设计）。

sentences.en: This is unrealistic, as most environments encountered in practice are either partially observable, or require function approximation that restricts the agent to access non-Markovian state features.
sentences.zh: 这是不现实的，因为实践中遇到的大多数环境要么是部分可观测的，要么需要将智能体对非马尔可夫状态特征的访问加以限制的函数逼近。

sentences.en: We consider the problem of learning an optimal reactive policy in a finite environment with deterministic observations (or equivalently, hard state aggregation).
sentences.zh: 我们考虑在一个具有确定性观测（或等价地，硬状态聚合）的有限环境中学习最优反应式策略的问题。

sentences.en: We introduce a new algorithm, _Committed Q-learning_, and prove almost-sure convergence to the optimal reactive policy under an intuitive assumption we call _rewire-robustness_.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个新算法 _Committed Q-learning_，并证明在我们称之为 _rewire-robustness_ 的直观假设下几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略。

sentences.en: This assumption is strictly weaker than the $q_\star$-realizability condition used in prior work.
sentences.zh: 这一假设严格弱于先前工作中使用的 $q_\star$-realizability 条件。

sentences.en: Our algorithm is a variant of classical Q-learning in which the behavior policy commits to a single action upon entering a feature, and only resamples actions when the observed feature changes.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法是经典 Q 学习的一个变体，其中行为策略在进入某一特征时承诺单一动作，并且仅在观测特征改变时才重新采样动作。

sentences.en: A crucial part of our analysis is the introduction of _quasi-Markov_ environments.
sentences.zh: 我们分析的一个关键部分是对 _quasi-Markov_（准马尔可夫）环境的引入。

title_en: Comp-Attn: Present-and-Align Attention for Compositional Video Generation
title_zh: Comp-Attn：用于组合式视频生成的呈现–对齐注意力

sentences.en: In the domain of text-to-video (T2V) generation, reliably synthesizing compositional content involving multiple subjects with intricate relations is still underexplored.
sentences.zh: 在文生视频（T2V）生成领域中，可靠地合成涉及多个具有复杂关系主体的组合式内容，仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: The main challenges are twofold: 1) Subject presence, where not all subjects can be presented in the video;
sentences.zh: 主要挑战有两方面：1）主体在场性，即并非所有主体都能出现在视频中；

sentences.en: 2) Inter-subject relations, where the interaction and spatial relationship between subjects are misaligned.
sentences.zh: 2）主体间关系，即主体之间的交互与空间关系错位。

sentences.en: Existing methods adopt techniques, such as inference-time latent optimization or layout control, which fail to address both issues simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 现有方法采用诸如推理时潜在优化或布局控制等技术，它们无法同时解决这两个问题。

sentences.en: To tackle these problems, we propose Comp-Attn, a composition-aware cross-attention variant that follows a ``Present-and-Align” paradigm: it decouples the two challenges by enforcing subject presence at the condition level and achieving relational alignment at the attention-distribution level.
sentences.zh: 为攻克这些问题，我们提出 Comp-Attn，一种组合感知的交叉注意力变体，它遵循“呈现与对齐”范式：通过在条件层面强化主体在场性、并在注意力分布层面实现关系对齐，将这两个挑战解耦。

sentences.en: Specifically, 1) We introduce Subject-aware Condition Interpolation (SCI) to reinforce subject-specific conditions and ensure each subject's presence;
sentences.zh: 具体而言，1）我们引入主体感知条件插值（SCI）来强化主体特定条件，确保每个主体的在场性；

sentences.en: 2) We propose Layout-forcing Attention Modulation (LAM), which dynamically enforces the attention distribution to align with the relational layout of multiple subjects.
sentences.zh: 2）我们提出布局强制注意力调制（LAM），它动态地强制注意力分布与多个主体的关系布局对齐。

sentences.en: Comp-Attn can be seamlessly integrated into various T2V baselines in a training-free manner, boosting T2V-CompBench scores by 15.7% and 11.7% on Wan2.1-T2V-14B and Wan2.2-T2V-A14B with only a 5% increase in inference time.
sentences.zh: Comp-Attn 可以以免训练的方式无缝集成到各种 T2V 基线中，在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 与 Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 上分别将 T2V-CompBench 分数提升 15.7% 与 11.7%，而推理时间仅增加 5%。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, it also achieves strong performance on VBench and T2I-CompBench, demonstrating its scalability in general T2V and compositional text-to-image (T2I) tasks.
sentences.zh: 同时，它在 VBench 与 T2I-CompBench 上也取得了强劲的性能，展示了其在一般 T2V 与组合式文生图（T2I）任务中的可扩展性。

sentences.en: Code and models are available at: https://github.com/Hong-yu-Zhang/Comp-attn.
sentences.zh: 代码与模型可在 https://github.com/Hong-yu-Zhang/Comp-attn 获取。

title_en: Compact Conformal Subgraphs
title_zh: 紧凑共形子图

sentences.en: Conformal prediction provides rigorous, distribution-free uncertainty guarantees, but often yields prohibitively large prediction sets in structured domains such as routing, planning, or sequential recommendation.
sentences.zh: 保形预测提供了严格的、无分布的不确定性保证，但在路由、规划或序列推荐等结构化领域中，往往会产生大得令人望而却步的预测集合。

sentences.en: We introduce graph-based conformal compression, a framework for constructing compact subgraphs that preserve statistical validity while reducing structural complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们引入基于图的保形压缩，一个构建紧凑子图的框架，它在降低结构复杂性的同时保持统计有效性。

sentences.en: We formulate compression as selecting a smallest subgraph capturing a prescribed fraction of the probability mass, and reduce to a weighted version of densest-k-subgraphs in hypergraphs, in the regime where the subgraph has a large fraction of edges.
sentences.zh: 我们将压缩表述为选择一个捕获给定比例概率质量的最小子图，并将其归约为超图中加权的最稠密 k 子图问题，此时子图具有较大比例的边。

sentences.en: We design efficient approximation algorithms that achieve constant factor coverage and size trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 我们设计了达到常数因子覆盖率与规模权衡的高效近似算法。

sentences.en: Crucially, we prove that our relaxation satisfies a monotonicity property, derived from a connection to parametric minimum cuts, which guarantees the nestedness required for valid conformal calibration.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们证明我们的松弛满足一个单调性性质，该性质源自与参数化最小割的联系，这保证了保形校准有效性所需的嵌套性。

sentences.en: Our results therefore not only highlight an algorithmic regime, distinct from classical densest-k-subgraph hardness settings, where the problem can be approximated efficiently, but also bridge conformal prediction with combinatorial graph compression via monotonicity.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的结果不仅凸显了一个与经典最稠密 k 子图困难设定截然不同的、问题可以被高效近似的算法情境，还通过单调性将保形预测与组合式图压缩联系起来。

sentences.en: We finally validate our algorithmic approach via simulations for trip planning and navigation, and compare to natural baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们最终通过行程规划与导航的仿真验证了我们的算法方法，并与自然基线进行了比较。

title_en: Comparing Deterministic and Soft Policy Gradients for Optimizing Gaussian Mixture Actors
title_zh: 比较用于优化高斯混合行动者的确定性策略梯度与软策略梯度

sentences.en: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) have been recently proposed for approximating actors in actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithms.
sentences.zh: 高斯混合模型（GMM）近来被提出来近似演员-批评家强化学习算法中的行动者。

sentences.en: Such GMM-based actors are commonly optimized using stochastic policy gradients along with an entropy maximization objective.
sentences.zh: 此类基于 GMM 的行动者通常使用随机策略梯度结合熵最大化目标进行优化。

sentences.en: In contrast to previous work, we define and study deterministic policy gradients for optimizing GMM-based actors.
sentences.zh: 与先前工作相反，我们定义并研究了用于优化基于 GMM 行动者的确定性策略梯度。

sentences.en: Similar to stochastic gradient approaches, our proposed method, denoted $\textit{Gaussian Mixture Deterministic Policy Gradient}$ (Gamid-PG), encourages policy entropy maximization.
sentences.zh: 与随机梯度方法类似，我们提出的方法（记为 $\textit{Gaussian Mixture Deterministic Policy Gradient}$（Gamid-PG，高斯混合确定性策略梯度）鼓励策略熵最大化。

sentences.en: To this end, we define the GMM entropy gradient using $\textit{Variational Approximation}$ of the $KL$-divergence between the GMM's constituting Gaussians.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们使用 GMM 各组成高斯之间 KL 散度的*变分近似*来定义 GMM 熵梯度。

sentences.en: We compare Gamid-PG with common stochastic policy gradient methods on benchmark dense-reward MuJoCo tasks and sparse-reward Fetch tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在基准密集奖励 MuJoCo 任务与稀疏奖励 Fetch 任务上比较了 Gamid-PG 与常见的随机策略梯度方法。

sentences.en: We observe that Gamid-PG outperforms stochastic gradient-based methods in 3/6 MuJoCo tasks while performing similarly on the remaining 3 tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，Gamid-PG 在 3/6 个 MuJoCo 任务上优于基于随机梯度的方法，而在其余 3 个任务上表现相当。

sentences.en: In the Fetch tasks, Gamid-PG outperforms single-actor deterministic gradient-based methods while performing worse than stochastic policy gradient methods.
sentences.zh: 在 Fetch 任务中，Gamid-PG 优于单行动者确定性梯度方法，而逊于随机策略梯度方法。

sentences.en: Consequently, we conclude that GMMs optimized using deterministic policy gradients (1) should be favorably considered over stochastic gradients in dense-reward continuous control tasks, and (2) improve upon single-actor deterministic gradients.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们得出结论：使用确定性策略梯度优化的 GMM（1）在密集奖励的连续控制任务中应优先于随机梯度加以考虑，并且（2）改进了单行动者确定性梯度。

title_en: Compass-RoPE: Isotropic Rotary Position Embeddings for Vision Transformers
title_zh: Compass-RoPE：视觉 Transformer 的各向同性旋转位置嵌入

sentences.en: Recent works introduce Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) into vision transformers (ViTs) to enhance their extrapolation capability, i.e., maintaining performance when inference is conducted on higher resolution images.
sentences.zh: 近期工作将旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）引入视觉 Transformer（ViT），以增强其外推能力，即在更高分辨率图像上进行推理时保持性能。

sentences.en: RoPE encodes positions via rotating phases whose change is controlled by frequency components.
sentences.zh: RoPE 通过旋转相位来编码位置，其变化由频率分量控制。

sentences.en: Strandard 2D RoPE does not generalize well to input resolution changes as it only applies axial frequencies separately along each individual axis.
sentences.zh: 标准的 2D RoPE 不能很好地泛化到输入分辨率变化，因为它仅沿每条单独的轴分别施加轴向频率。

sentences.en: To solve this issue, Mix-RoPE combines xy‑axis frequencies, such that it can model position relations in diagonal direction.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，Mix-RoPE 组合了 xy 轴频率，从而能够建模对角方向的位置关系。

sentences.en: However, in practice, we observe that the learned 2D frequencies become anisotropic in their direction distributions due to the axial spectral bias in image features, limiting the extrapolation ability of ViTs.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，我们观察到，由于图像特征中的轴向谱偏差，学习到的 2D 频率在其方向分布上会变得各向异性，从而限制了 ViT 的外推能力。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Compass‑RoPE.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们提出 Compass-RoPE。

sentences.en: We replace the xy cartesian coordinates with a polar parameterization that explicitly decouples frequency scale and angle.
sentences.zh: 我们用极坐标参数化取代 xy 笛卡尔坐标，它显式地解耦了频率尺度与角度。

sentences.en: By initializing the angle vectors uniformly over [0,2π), it ensures the isotropic direction coverage.
sentences.zh: 通过在 $[0,2\pi)$ 上均匀初始化角度向量，它确保了各向同性的方向覆盖。

sentences.en: Besides, we further introduce discrete Fourier transform (DFT) mixing for the angle vectors, allowing each transformed individual angle vector element to nest multipule angles and thus to enrich angular expressiveness.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们进一步为角度向量引入离散傅里叶变换（DFT）混合，使变换后的各个角度向量元素能够嵌套多个角度，从而丰富角度表达力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multi-resolution classification and dense prediction tasks show that our Compass-RoPE achieves more stable extrapolation performance under large-scale resolution changes.
sentences.zh: 在多分辨率分类与密集预测任务上的大量实验表明，我们的 Compass-RoPE 在大规模分辨率变化下取得了更稳定的外推性能。

title_en: Compile to Compress: Boosting Formal Theorem Provers by Compiler Outputs
title_zh: 编译以压缩：利用编译器输出增强形式化定理证明器

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in formal theorem proving, yet state-of-the-art performance often necessitates prohibitive test-time compute via massive roll-outs or extended context windows.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在形式化定理证明中展现出巨大潜力，然而最先进的性能往往需要通过大规模 roll-out 或扩展的上下文窗口来付出令人望而却步的测试时计算。

sentences.en: In this work, we address this scalability bottleneck by exploiting an informative structure in formal verification: the observation that compilers map a vast space of diverse proof attempts to a compact set of structured failure modes.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过利用形式化验证中的一个有信息量的结构来应对这一可扩展性瓶颈：即编译器将广阔的、多种多样的证明尝试空间映射到一个紧凑的、结构化的失败模式集合这一观察。

sentences.en: We introduce a learning-to-refine framework that leverages this compression to perform efficient learning and proof exploration.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个学习精炼框架，它利用这种压缩来进行高效的学习与证明探索。

sentences.en: We perform tree search that corrects errors locally conditioned on explicit verifier feedback, thereby circumventing the costs associated with accumulating a long history of proof attempts.
sentences.zh: 我们执行树搜索，在条件于显式验证器反馈的情况下局部地纠正错误，从而规避了累积长序列证明尝试历史的成本。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations show that our method consistently amplifies the reasoning capabilities of base provers across varying scales.
sentences.zh: 大量评估表明，我们的方法在不同规模下一致地放大了基础证明器的推理能力。

sentences.en: Notably, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on PutnamBench among publicly reported $\sim$8B and $\sim$32B parameter models under comparable test-time budgets, offering a scalable paradigm for next-generation verifier-guided reasoning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在可比较的测试时预算下，我们的方法在 PutnamBench 上于公开报道的约 8B 与约 32B 参数模型中取得了最先进的性能对话，为下一代验证器引导的推理提供了可扩展的范式。

title_en: CompleteP for RL: Maintaining Feature Learning When Scaling Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用于强化学习的 CompleteP：扩展深度强化学习时保持特征学习

sentences.en: The maximal update parameterization ($\mu P$) provides an approach to scale parameters while preserving feature learning in deep neural networks.
sentences.zh: 最大更新参数化（ComputeP）提供了一种在扩展参数的同时保持深度神经网络特征学习的方法。

sentences.en: In fixed data distribution settings it has been found to yield more stable learning dynamics, more consistent learned features, and enable optimal hyperparameters such as learning rate to transfer from small models to larger ones.
sentences.zh: 在固定数据分布设定下，已发现它能产生更稳定的学习动态、更一致的所学特征，并能使学习率等最优超参数从小模型迁移到更大模型。

sentences.en: However, it is unclear if these benefits readily transfer to reinforcement learning problems, where learning dynamics are coupled to the non-stationary data distribution induced by an agent's own actions.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些益处是否容易迁移到强化学习问题并不清楚，因为那里的学习动态与智能体自身动作所诱导的非平稳数据分布耦合在一起。

sentences.en: We empirically study how two regimes, the ''rich'' CompleteP and ''lazy'' Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) parameterizations affect hyperparameter transfer, feature and policy consistency, and learning behavior as we scale reinforcement learning agents.
sentences.zh: 我们从经验上研究“丰富”的 ComputeP 与“惰性”的神经正切核（NTK）两种参数化如何影响超参数迁移、特征与策略一致性，以及我们在扩展强化学习智能体时的学习行为。

sentences.en: Ultimately, we show that agents trained using CompleteP consequentially improves compute and reward efficiency compared to the NTK parameterization across multiple control tasks and variants.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们表明，在多个控制任务及其变体上，使用 ComputeP 训练的智能体相较于 NTK 参数化显著提高了计算效率与奖励效率。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Complexity Bounds for Dirichlet Process Slice Samplers
title_zh: 狄利克雷过程切片采样器的复杂度界

sentences.en: Slice sampling is a standard Monte Carlo technique for Dirichlet process (DP)-based models, widely used in posterior simulation.
sentences.zh: 切片采样是基于 Dirichlet 过程（DP）模型的标准蒙特卡罗技术，广泛用于后验模拟。

sentences.en: However, formal assessments of the scalability of posterior slice samplers have remained largely unexplored, primarily because the computational cost of a slice-sampling iteration is random and potentially unbounded.
sentences.zh: 然而，对后验切片采样器可扩展性的正式评估在很大程度上仍未得到探索，这主要是因为切片采样迭代的计算成本是随机的，并且可能是无界的。

sentences.en: In this work, we obtain high-probability bounds on the computational complexity of DP slice samplers.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们获得了 DP 切片采样器计算复杂度的较高概率界。

sentences.en: Our main results show that, uniformly across posterior cluster-growth regimes, the overhead induced by slice variables, relatively to the number of clusters supported by the posterior, is $O_{\mathbb P}(\log n)$.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要结果表明，在后验聚类增长情境下，切片变量相对于后验所支持的聚类数量引入的开销为 $O_{\mathbb P}(\log n)$。

sentences.en: As a consequence, even in worst-case configurations, superlinear blow-ups in per-iteration computational cost occur with vanishing probability.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在最坏情况配置下，每次迭代计算成本的超线性爆发也以趋于零的概率发生。

sentences.en: Our analysis applies broadly to DP--based models without any likelihood-specific assumptions, still providing complexity guarantees for posterior sampling on arbitrary datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析广泛适用于基于 DP 的模型，无需任何依赖于似然性的假设，仍然为任意数据集上的后验采样提供复杂度保证。

sentences.en: These results establish a theoretical foundation for assessing the practical scalability of slice sampling in DP-based models.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为评估基于 DP 模型中切片采样的实际可扩展性奠定了理论基础。

title_en: Complexity of Decentralized Optimization with Mixed Affine Constraints
title_zh: 混合仿射约束下去中心化优化的复杂度

sentences.en: This paper considers decentralized optimization of convex functions with mixed affine equality constraints involving both local and global variables.
sentences.zh: 本文考虑带涉及局部变量与全局变量的混合仿射等式约束的凸函数分布式优化。

sentences.en: Constraints on global variables may vary across different nodes in the network, while local variables are subject to coupled and node-specific constraints.
sentences.zh: 对全局变量的约束可能随网络中不同节点而变化，而局部变量则受耦合且节点特定的约束。

sentences.en: Such problem formulations arise in machine learning applications, including federated learning and multi-task learning, as well as in resource allocation and distributed control.
sentences.zh: 此类问题表述出现在机器学习应用中，包括联邦学习、多任务学习，以及资源分配与分布式控制中。

sentences.en: We analyze this problem under smooth and non-smooth assumptions, considering both strongly convex and general convex objective functions.
sentences.zh: 我们在光滑与非光滑假设下分析这一问题，同时考虑强凸与一般凸目标函数。

sentences.en: Our main contribution is an optimal algorithm for the smooth, strongly convex regime, whose convergence rate matches established lower complexity bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要贡献是光滑强凸情形下的一个最优算法，其收敛速率与既定的复杂度下界相匹配。

sentences.en: We further provide optimal and near-optimal methods for the remaining cases.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步为其余情形提供了最优与近最优的方法。

title_en: ComplexMCP: Evaluation of LLM Agents in Dynamic, Interdependent, and Large-Scale Tool Sandbox
title_zh: ComplexMCP：在动态、相互依赖的大规模工具沙箱中评估大语言模型智能体

sentences.en: Current LLM agents are proficient at calling isolated APIs but struggle with the "last mile" of commercial software automation.
sentences.zh: 当前的 LLM 智能体擅长调用隔离的 API，但在商业软件自动化的“最后一公里”上表现挣扎。

sentences.en: In real-world scenarios, tools are not independent; they are atomic, interdependent, and prone to environmental noise.
sentences.zh: 在现实场景中，工具并非独立的；它们是原子的、相互依赖的，并且容易受到环境噪声的影响。

sentences.en: We introduce $\textbf{ComplexMCP}$, a benchmark designed to evaluate agents in these rigorous conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 $\textbf{ComplexMCP}$，一个旨在这些严苛条件下评估智能体的基准。

sentences.en: Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), $\textbf{ComplexMCP}$ provides over 300 meticulously tested tools derived from 7 stateful sandboxes, ranging from office suites to financial systems.
sentences.zh: 基于模型上下文协议（MCP），$\textbf{ComplexMCP}$ 提供了从 7 个有状态沙箱（从办公套件到金融系统）派生出的 300 多个经过精心测试的工具。

sentences.en: Unlike existing datasets, our benchmark utilizes a seed-driven architecture to simulate dynamic environment states and unpredictable API failures, ensuring a deterministic yet diverse evaluation.
sentences.zh: 与现有数据集不同，我们的基准利用种子驱动的架构来模拟动态环境状态与不可预测的 API 故障，确保确定性而又多样化的评估。

sentences.en: We evaluate various LLMs across full-context and RAG paradigms, revealing a stark performance gap: even top-tier models fail to exceed a 60% success rate, far trailing human performance 90%.
sentences.zh: 我们在全上下文与 RAG 范式下评估了各种 LLM，揭示出一个惊人的性能差距：即使顶级模型也无法超过 60% 的成功率，远落后于人类 90% 的表现。

sentences.en: Granular trajectory analysis identifies three fundamental bottlenecks: (1) $\textbf{tool retrieval saturation}$ as action spaces scale;
sentences.zh: 细粒度的轨迹分析识别出三个根本性瓶颈：（1）$\textbf{tool retrieval saturation}$，随动作空间扩展；

sentences.en: (2) $\textbf{over-confidence}$, where agents skip essential environment verifications; and (3) $\textbf{strategic defeatism}$, a tendency to rationalize failure rather than pursuing recovery.
sentences.zh: （2）$\textbf{over-confidence}$，智能体跳过必要的环境验证；以及（3）$\textbf{strategic defeatism}$，一种将失败合理化而非寻求恢复的倾向。

sentences.en: These findings underscore the insufficiency of current agents for interdependent workflows, positioning $\textbf{ComplexMCP}$ as a critical testbed for the next generation of resilient autonomous systems.
sentences.zh: 这些发现凸显了当前智能体对相互依赖工作流的不足，将 $\textbf{ComplexMCP}$ 定位为下一代韧性自主系统的关键测试平台。

sentences.en: The codebase and benchmark implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/AIDC-AI/complex-mcp.
sentences.zh: 代码库与基准实现公开于 https://github.com/AIDC-AI/complex-mcp。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Component-Wise Composite Likelihood Distillation for Censored Time-to-Event Data
title_zh: 用于删失事件发生时间数据的逐组件复合似然蒸馏

sentences.en: Accurate survival modeling in biomedical studies is often hindered by rare events, limited effective sample sizes, and settings with limited or partially observed information (e.g., covariates of interest that are difficult or expensive to collect, highly structured sampling designs, or nuisance parameters omitted by conditioning).
sentences.zh: 生物医学研究中的准确生存建模常常受到罕发事件、有限的有效样本量，以及信息有限或部分可观测的设定（例如难以或昂贵收集的感兴趣协变量、高度结构化的抽样设计，或因取条件而被省略的干扰参数）的阻碍。

sentences.en: Knowledge distillation can leverage external predictive information without sharing individual-level data, but existing approaches are largely built for fully specified likelihoods or probability-based survival models and do not extend to settings where outcome distributions are only partially specified.
sentences.zh: 知识蒸馏可以在不共享个体级数据的情况下利用外部的预测信息，但现有方法很大程度上是为完全指定的似然或基于概率的生存模型构建的，无法扩展到结果分布仅被部分指定的设定。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a knowledge distillation framework based on a composite-likelihood Kullback--Leibler divergence that aligns teacher and student models within components.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个基于复合似然 Kullback-Leibler 散度的知识蒸馏框架，它在各分量内对齐教师与学生模型。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that, although composite likelihoods do not define a global outcome distribution, each likelihood component induces a well-defined probability model on its restricted outcome space, enabling a principled KL divergence.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，虽然复合似然并未定义一个全局结果分布，但每个似然分量在其受限结果空间上诱导出一个定义良好的概率模型，从而能够实现有原则的 KL 散度。

sentences.en: Simulation studies and biomedical case studies show improved discrimination and predictive accuracy in rare-event, heterogeneous settings without requiring access to external individual-level data.
sentences.zh: 仿真研究与生物医学案例研究显示，在无需访问外部个体级数据的情况下，罕发、异构设定中的判别力与预测精度得到提升。

title_en: Compositional Behavioral Semantics for State Abstraction in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 强化学习状态抽象的组合行为语义

sentences.en: State abstraction plays a key role in scaling reinforcement learning to complex but structured systems.
sentences.zh: 状态抽象在将强化学习扩展到复杂但有结构的系统方面起着关键作用。

sentences.en: In studying such systems, a wide range of behavioral structures have been studied in reinforcement learning, including value functions, invariants, bisimulation relations, and behavioral metrics.
sentences.zh: 在研究此类系统时，强化学习中对广泛的行为结构进行了研究，包括价值函数、不变量、互模拟关系与行为度量。

sentences.en: However, a general principle for determining what structures are provably preserved under state abstraction is still lacking.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于确定哪些结构在状态抽象下可被证明地保持的一般性原则仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present a unified framework for defining and analyzing behavioral structures in reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个用于定义与分析强化学习中行为结构的统一框架。

sentences.en: Our framework provides a compositional way to specify behavioral semantics based on local, one-step descriptions of system dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架提供了一种基于系统动力学的局部、单步描述来指定行为语义的组成式方法。

sentences.en: Using this framework, we establish results showing how behavioral structures can be safely transferred between abstract and concrete systems.
sentences.zh: 利用这一框架，我们确立了表明行为结构如何在抽象系统与具体系统之间安全迁移的结果。

sentences.en: We further show how to construct quantitative metrics from logical behavioral semantics with soundness guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步展示了如何以可靠性的保证从逻辑行为语义构造定量度量。

sentences.en: Together, these results provide a principled foundation for reasoning about behaviors under state abstraction in reinforcement learning and offer reusable definition and proof principles for a broad class of behavioral structures in reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同为在强化学习状态抽象下对行为进行推理提供了有原则的基础，并为强化学习中一大类行为结构提供了可复用的定义与证明原则。

title_en: Compositional Generalization Requires Linear, Orthogonal Representations in Vision Embedding Models
title_zh: 视觉嵌入模型的组合泛化需要线性且正交的表征

sentences.en: Compositional generalization, the ability to recognize familiar parts in novel contexts, is a defining property of intelligent systems, yet modern models, despite massive training sets, see only a tiny fraction of the combinatorial input space.
sentences.zh: 组合泛化，即在新颖语境中识别熟悉部分的能力，是智能系统的标志性属性，然而现代模型尽管拥有海量训练集，也只能看到组合输入空间中极小一部分。

sentences.en: We ask what structure representations {must} have to support generalization to unseen combinations.
sentences.zh: 我们追问：表示必须具备何种结构，才能支持对未见组合的泛化？

sentences.en: We formalize three desiderata (divisibility, transferability, stability) and show they impose necessary geometric constraints under standard training: representations must decompose linearly into per-concept components, orthogonal across concepts.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化了三个期望性质（可分性、可迁移性、稳定性），并表明它们在标准训练下施加了必要的几何约束：表示必须线性分解为逐概念的分量，且跨概念正交。

sentences.en: This grounds the Linear Representation Hypothesis as a necessary consequence of compositional generalization, and yields dimension bounds linking the number of composable concepts to embedding geometry.
sentences.zh: 这将线性表示假设夯实为组合泛化的必要条件，并导出了将可组合概念数量与嵌入几何联系起来的维度界。

sentences.en: Empirically, across CLIP, SigLIP, and DINO, we find partial linear factorization with low-rank near-orthogonal per-concept factors, and the degree of this structure correlates with compositional generalization on unseen combinations.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，跨 CLIP、SigLIP 与 DINO，我们发现了具有低秩近正交逐概念因子的部分线性分解，而这种结构的程度与对未见组合的组合泛化相关。

sentences.en: As models continue to scale, these conditions predict the geometry they may converge to.
sentences.zh: 随着模型继续扩展，这些条件预测了它们可能收敛到的几何形态。

sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/oshapio/necessary-compositionality

title_en: Compositional Generative Modeling from Decentralized Data
title_zh: 利用去中心化数据进行组合式生成建模

sentences.en: Learning the compositional nature of the physical world requires joint observation of interacting factors.
sentences.zh: 学习物理世界的组成性本质，需要对相互作用因子进行联合观测。

sentences.en: However, because practical data is often decentralized, these factors are fragmented across isolated silos.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于实际数据往往是去中心化的，这些因子被碎片化地分散在彼此隔离的孤岛中。

sentences.en: Existing decentralized generative approaches focus only on modeling the union of siloed data, overlooking novel combinations implied by the collective whole.
sentences.zh: 现有的去中心化生成方法只关注对孤立数据并集的建模，忽视了由集合整体所蕴含的新颖组合。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce Decentralized Compositional Flow Matching (DCFM), a framework that enforces structural constraints across the global set of generative factors, without exchanging any raw data.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入去中心化组成式流匹配（DCFM），一个在全局生成因子集合上强制执行结构约束、却不交换任何原始数据的框架。

sentences.en: DCFM enables novel combinations to emerge through peer interactions, even when no single data source can independently support the composition.
sentences.zh: 即使没有任何单一数据源能够独立支撑某种组合，DCFM 也能通过同伴交互使新颖组合涌现。

sentences.en: Empirically, DCFM substantially outperforms federated learning and mixture-of-experts baselines across conditional image generation, robotic spatial planning, and medical attribute co-occurrence modeling.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，在条件图像生成、机器人空间规划与医学属性共现建模中，DCFM 大幅优于联邦学习与混合专家基线。

title_en: Compositional Planning with Jumpy World Models
title_zh: 利用跳跃式世界模型进行组合规划

sentences.en: The ability to plan with temporal abstractions is central to intelligent decision-making.
sentences.zh: 以时间抽象进行规划的能力是智能决策的核心。

sentences.en: Rather than reasoning over primitive actions, we study agents that compose pre-trained policies as temporally extended actions, enabling solutions to complex tasks that no constituent alone can solve.
sentences.zh: 与在原始动作上推理不同，我们研究将预训练策略组合为时间扩展动作的智能体，从而能够求解没有任何单一组成成分能够单独求解的复杂任务。

sentences.en: Such compositional planning remains elusive as compounding errors in long-horizon predictions make it challenging to estimate the visitation distribution induced by sequencing policies.
sentences.zh: 这类组合式规划仍然难以实现，因为长时序预测中的复合误差使估计由策略序列化所诱导的访问分布颇具挑战。

sentences.en: Motivated by the geometric policy composition framework introduced in Thakoor et al. (2022), we address these challenges by learning predictive models of multi-step dynamics --- so-called jumpy world models --- that capture state occupancies induced by pre-trained policies across multiple timescales in an off-policy manner.
sentences.zh: 受 Thakoor 等人（2022）引入的几何策略组合框架的启发，我们通过学习多步动力学预测模型——即所谓的跳跃世界模型（jumpy world models）——来应对这些挑战，该模型以off-policy方式捕获由预训练策略在多个时间尺度上诱导的状态占用。

sentences.en: Building on Temporal Difference Flows (Farebrother et al., 2025), we enhance these models with a novel consistency objective that aligns predictions across timescales, improving long-horizon predictive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 基于时序差分流（Farebrother 等人，2025），我们通过一个新颖的一致性目标增强这些模型，该目标跨时间尺度对齐预测，提升长时序预测精度。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate how to combine these generative predictions to estimate the value of executing arbitrary sequences of policies over varying timescales.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步展示如何组合这些生成式预测，以估计在不同时间尺度上执行任意策略序列的价值。

sentences.en: Empirically, we find that compositional planning with jumpy world models significantly improves zero-shot performance across a wide range of base policies on challenging manipulation and navigation tasks, yielding, on average, a 200% relative improvement over planning with primitive actions on long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们发现，在具有挑战性的操作与导航任务上，带跳跃世界模型的组合式规划在广泛的基础策略上显著提升零样本性能，在长时序任务上相较于用原始动作规划平均实现了 200% 的相对改进。

title_en: Compositional Transduction with Latent Analogies for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 利用潜在类比进行组合转导，以支持离线目标条件强化学习

sentences.en: Compositional generalization is essential for reaching unseen goals under novel contextual variations in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), where a generalist goal-reaching agent must be learned from limited data.
sentences.zh: 组合泛化对于在离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中于新颖语境变化下达到未见目标至关重要，此时必须从有限数据中学习一个通用的目标达成智能体。

sentences.en: Most prior approaches pursue this via trajectory stitching over temporally contiguous segments, which limits composing behaviors across varying contexts.
sentences.zh: 大多数先前方法通过时间上连续片段间的轨迹拼接来追求这一目标，这限制了跨不同语境组合行为的能力。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we formalize *analogy transduction* as synthesizing new plans by composing task-endogenous analogies with given contexts and propose a novel analogy representation tailored for it.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们将*类比转导*形式化为通过将任务内生的类比与给定语境相组合来合成新计划，并提出一种为此量身定制的类比表示。

sentences.en: Grounded in our theory, this analogy representation captures what changes under optimal task execution, remains invariant to contextual variations, and is sufficient for optimal goal reaching.
sentences.zh: 以我们的理论为基础，这一类比表示捕获了最优任务执行下发生变化的内容，对语境变化保持不变，并且足以实现最优目标达成。

sentences.en: We further contend that generalization to unseen analogy-context pairs is a practical obstacle in analogy transduction, and introduce a new approach for offline GCRL that enables analogy transduction beyond seen pairs to unseen combinations.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步认为，对未见过的类比-语境对进行泛化是类比转导中的一个实际障碍，并引入一种新的离线 GCRL 方法，使类比转导能够超越已见对，推广到未见组合。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on OGBench manipulation environments, substantially outperforming prior methods that do not perform analogy transduction.
sentences.zh: 我们在经验上证明了我们的方法在 OGBench 操作环境上的有效性，大幅优于先前不进行类比转导的方法。

title_en: Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter
title_zh: 先压缩再合并：将多个 LoRA 转换为单个低秩适配器

sentences.en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient specialization of foundation models, but the proliferation of task-specific adapters fragments capabilities across many adapters, complicating reuse and deployment.
sentences.zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）实现了基础模型的参数高效专门化，但任务特定适配器的激增使能力在众多适配器间碎片化，使复用与部署复杂化。

sentences.en: We study the problem of **merging $T$ LoRAs into a single rank-$r$ LoRA**, thereby preserving the benefits of low-rank structure.
sentences.zh: 我们研究将 $T$ 个 LoRA 合并为一个秩-$r$ LoRA 的问题，从而保留低秩结构的益处。

sentences.en: Existing Merge-then-Compress pipelines treat the rank constraint as an afterthought: they merge adapters in the full parameter space, then compress the merged result to rank $r$ via truncated SVD.
sentences.zh: 现有的“先合并后压缩”流程将秩约束视为事后考虑：他们在完整参数空间中合并适配器，然后通过截断 SVD 将合并结果压缩到秩-$r$。

sentences.en: However, full-parameter merging may destroy the low-rank structure, making it difficult for subsequent compression to recover an effective rank-$r$ LoRA.
sentences.zh: 然而，全参数合并可能破坏低秩结构，使随后的压缩难以恢复出有效的秩-$r$ LoRA。

sentences.en: We propose Compress-then-Merge (CtM), a reversed pipeline that enforces the rank-$r$ bottleneck _before_ merging: CtM computes shared $r$-dimensional subspaces using only the LoRA weights to capture cross-adapter common structure, projects each adapter into the shared subspaces to obtain $r\times r$ coordinates, and then applies standard merging rules in this reduced space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出“先压缩再合并”（CtM），一种颠倒的流程，它在合并*之前*强制执行秩-$r$ 瓶颈：CtM 仅使用 LoRA 权重计算共享的 $r$-维子空间以捕获跨适配器的共同结构，将每个适配器投影到共享子空间以获得 $r\times r$ 坐标，然后在此约化空间中应用标准合并规则。

sentences.en: CtM guarantees a rank-$r$ LoRA by construction, avoiding post-hoc truncation, and enables efficient computation in the core space spanned by concatenated LoRA factors.
sentences.zh: CtM 通过构造保证了秩-$r$ LoRA，避免了事后截断，并能够在由拼接的 LoRA 因子张成的最小核心空间中实现高效计算。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple models and tasks show that CtM consistently outperforms existing single-LoRA-output baselines while narrowing the performance gap to full-parameter merging methods.
sentences.zh: 跨多个模型与任务的实验表明，CtM 一致地优于现有的单 LoRA 输出基线，同时缩小了与全参数合并方法的性能差距。

title_en: Compressed Sensing for Capability Localization in Large Language Models
title_zh: 用于大语言模型能力定位的压缩感知

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a wide range of capabilities, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and linguistic behaviors.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出广泛的能力，包括数学推理、代码生成与语言行为。

sentences.en: We show that Transformer architectures contain small subsets of attention heads that are necessary for certain capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，Transformer 架构包含对某些能力不可或缺的小部分注意力头子集。

sentences.en: Zeroing out as few as five task-specific heads can degrade performance by up to $60\\%$ on standard benchmarks measuring the capability of interest, while largely preserving performance on unrelated tasks.
sentences.zh: 仅将五个任务特定的注意力头归零，就能在度量该能力的标准基准上使性能下降多达 60\%，而在很大程度上保持无关任务上的性能。

sentences.en: We introduce a compressed sensing-based method that exploits the sparsity of these heads to identify them via strategic knockouts and a small number of model evaluations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种基于压缩感知的方法，利用这些注意力头的稀疏性，通过策略性剔除与少量模型评估来识别它们。

sentences.en: We validate these findings across Llama and Qwen models ranging from 1B to 14B parameters and a diverse set of capabilities including mathematical abilities and code generation, revealing a modular organization in which specialized capabilities are dependent on sparse, functionally distinct components.
sentences.zh: 我们在从 1B 到 14B 参数的 Llama 与 Qwen 模型以及包括数学能力与代码生成在内的多种能力上验证了这些发现，揭示了一种模块化组织，其中专门能力依赖于稀疏的、功能上不同的组件。

sentences.en: Overall, our results suggest that capability localization is a general organizational principle of Transformer language models, with implications for interpretability, model editing, and AI safety.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，能力定位是 Transformer 语言模型的一种一般性组织原则，对可解释性、模型编辑与 AI 安全都有影响。

sentences.en: Code is released at https://github.com/locuslab/llm-components.
sentences.zh: 代码发布在 https://github.com/locuslab/llm-components。

title_en: Compression as Adaptation: Implicit Visual Representation with Diffusion Foundation Models
title_zh: 以压缩实现适配：利用扩散基础模型构建隐式视觉表示

sentences.en: Modern visual generative models acquire rich visual knowledge through large-scale training, yet existing visual representations (such as pixels, latents, or tokens) remain external to the model and cannot directly exploit this knowledge for compact storage or reuse.
sentences.zh: 现代视觉生成模型通过大规模训练获取丰富的视觉知识，然而现有的视觉表示（例如像素、潜变量或词元）仍是模型外部的，无法直接利用这一知识进行紧凑存储或复用。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a new visual representation framework that encodes a signal as a function,  which is parametrized by low-rank adaptations attached to a frozen visual generative model.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入一个新的视觉表示框架，它将信号编码为一个函数，该函数由附着在冻结的视觉生成模型上的低秩适配参数化。

sentences.en: Such implicit representations of visual signals, \textit{e.g.}, an 81-frame video, can further be hashed into a single compact vector, achieving strong perceptual video compression at extremely low bitrates.
sentences.zh: 此类视觉信号的隐式表示（*例如*一段 81 帧的视频）可以进一步哈希为单个紧凑向量，从而在极低码率下实现强大的感知视频压缩。

sentences.en: Beyond basic compression, the functional nature of this representation enables inference-time scaling and control, allowing additional refinement on the compression performance.
sentences.zh: 除了基本压缩之外，这一表示的函数性质使其能够进行推理时扩展与控制，允许对压缩性能进行额外的精炼。

sentences.en: More broadly, as the implicit representations directly act as a function of the generation process, this suggests a unified framework bridging visual compression and generation.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，由于隐式表示直接充当生成过程的一个函数，这暗示着一个弥合视觉压缩与生成的统一框架。

title_en: Computational Arbitrage in AI Model Markets
title_zh: AI 模型市场中的计算套利

sentences.en: Consider a market of competing model providers selling query access to models with varying costs and capabilities.
sentences.zh: 考虑一个由相互竞争的模型提供商组成的市场，它们以不同的成本与能力出售对模型的查询访问权限。

sentences.en: Customers submit problem instances and are willing to pay up to a budget for a verifiable solution.
sentences.zh: 客户提交问题实例，并愿意为可验证的解决方案支付不超过预算的金额。

sentences.en: An arbitrageur efficiently allocates inference budget across providers to undercut the market, thus creating a competitive offering with no model-development risk.
sentences.zh: 一个套利者跨提供商高效地分配推理预算以压低市场价格，从而在毫无模型开发风险的情况下创造一个有竞争力的产品。

sentences.en: In this work, we initiate the study of arbitrage in AI model markets, empirically demonstrating the viability of arbitrage and illustrating its economic consequences.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们开启了 AI 模型市场中套利的研究，实证地证明了套利的可行性，并说明了其经济后果。

sentences.en: We conduct an in-depth case study of SWE-bench GitHub issue resolution using two representative models, GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek v3.2.
sentences.zh: 我们使用两个具有代表性的模型 GPT-5 mini 与 DeepSeek v3.2，对 SWE-bench GitHub 问题解决进行了一项深入案例研究。

sentences.en: In this verifiable domain, simple arbitrage strategies generate net profit margins of up to 40\%.
sentences.zh: 在这个可验证的领域中，简单的套利策略能产生高达 40\% 的净利润率。

sentences.en: Robust arbitrage strategies that generalize across different domains remain profitable.
sentences.zh: 能够跨不同领域泛化的稳健套利策略仍然有利可图。

sentences.en: Distillation further creates strong arbitrage opportunities, potentially at the expense of the teacher model’s revenue.
sentences.zh: 蒸馏进一步创造了强大的套利机会，代价可能是教师模型的收入。

sentences.en: Multiple competing arbitrageurs drive down consumer prices, reducing the marginal revenue of model providers.
sentences.zh: 多个相互竞争的套利者压低消费者价格，降低了模型提供商的边际收入。

sentences.en: At the same time, arbitrage reduces market segmentation and facilitates market entry for smaller model providers by enabling earlier revenue capture.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，套利减少了市场分割，并通过使较小模型提供商能够更早获取收入，促进了它们的市场进入。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that arbitrage can be a powerful force in AI model markets with implications for model development, distillation, and deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，套利可以成为 AI 模型市场中的一股强大力量，对模型开发、蒸馏与部署都有影响。

title_en: Computationally-efficient Graph Modeling with Refined Graph Random Features
title_zh: 利用精细化图随机特征实现计算高效的图建模

sentences.en: We propose *refined GRFs* (GRFs++), a new class of *Graph Random Features* (GRFs) for efficient and accurate computations involving kernels defined on the nodes of a graph.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*精修图随机特征*（GRFs++），一类新的*图随机特征*（GRFs），用于涉及定义在图节点上核的计算，既高效又精确。

sentences.en: GRFs++ resolve some of the long-standing limitations of regular GRFs, including difficulty modeling relationships between more distant nodes.
sentences.zh: GRFs++ 解决了常规 GRF 的一些长期局限，包括难以建模相距更远节点之间的关系。

sentences.en: They reduce dependence on sampling long graph random walks via a novel *walk-stitching* technique, concatenating several shorter walks without breaking unbiasedness.
sentences.zh: 它们通过一种新颖的*走法缝合*（walk-stitching）技术减少对采样长图随机游走的依赖，在保持无偏性的同时拼接若干较短的游走。

sentences.en: By applying these techniques, GRFs++ inherit the approximation quality provided by longer walks but with greater efficiency, trading sequential inefficient sampling of a long walk for parallel computation of short walks and matrix-matrix multiplication.
sentences.zh: 通过应用这些技术，GRFs++ 继承了更长游走提供的逼近质量，但效率更高，将长游走的顺序低效采样转化为短游走的并行计算与矩阵-矩阵乘法。

sentences.en: Furthermore, GRFs++ extend the simplistic GRFs walk termination mechanism (Bernoulli schemes with fixed halting probabilities) to a broader class of strategies, applying general distributions on the walks' lengths.
sentences.zh: 此外，GRFs++ 将简化的 GRF 游走终止机制（具有固定停止概率的 Bernoulli 方案）扩展到更广泛的策略类别，在游走长度上应用一般分布。

sentences.en: This improves approximation accuracy of graph kernels, without incurring extra computational cost.
sentences.zh: 这提升了图核的逼近精度，而无需额外计算成本。

sentences.en: We provide empirical evaluations to showcase our claims and complement our results with theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了实证评估来展示我们的主张，并用理论分析补充我们的结果。

title_en: Compute as Teacher: Turning Inference Compute Into Reference-Free Supervision
title_zh: 以计算为教师：将推理计算转化为无需参考的监督

sentences.en: Where do learning signals come from when there is no ground truth in post-training?
sentences.zh: 当后训练中没有真实标签时，学习信号从哪里来？

sentences.en: We show that inference compute itself can serve as supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，推理算力本身就可以充当监督。

sentences.en: By generating parallel rollouts and converting them into reference estimates, models can learn without human labels—critically, even in non-verifiable domains like healthcare guidance where no programmatic checker exists.
sentences.zh: 通过生成并行 rollout 并将其转化为参考估计，模型可以在没有人类标签的情况下学习——关键在于，即使是在医疗保健指导等不存在程序化检查器的不可验证领域中也是如此。

sentences.en: We call this framework *Compute as Teacher (CaT)* and it turns inference-time compute from parallel rollouts into supervision for RL training.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一框架称为*计算即教师*（Compute as Teacher，CaT），它把来自并行 rollout 的推理时算力转化为用于 RL 训练的监督。

sentences.en: The framework has two components: (1) reference estimation which aggregates rollouts into a pseudo-reference answer, and (2) reward derivation which converts that pseudo-reference into RL rewards.
sentences.zh: 该框架有两个组成部分：（1）参考估计，将 rollout 聚合为伪参考答案；以及（2）奖励推导，将该伪参考答案转化为 RL 奖励。

sentences.en: For (1), we explore a simple method we call *synthesis*, but the framework admits any aggregator.
sentences.zh: 对于（1），我们探索了一种我们称之为*合成*（synthesis）的简单方法，但该框架允许任何聚合器。

sentences.en: For (2), we introduce self-proposed rubrics for non-verifiable domains.
sentences.zh: 对于（2），我们为不可验证领域引入自提议的评分细则（rubrics）。

sentences.en: These are binary, auditable criteria generated from the pseudo-reference and scored by an LLM judge.
sentences.zh: 这些是从伪参考答案生成的二元、可审计标准，并由一个 LLM 评判者评分。

sentences.en: On HealthBench, models trained with CaT match or exceed inference-time aggregation quality while using 9× less test-time compute.
sentences.zh: 在 HealthBench 上，用 CaT 训练的模型匹敌或超越了推理时聚合质量，同时使用的测试时算力减少了 9×。

sentences.en: Here, CaT also competes with learning from expert physician annotations, yielding up to +30% relative improvement over the initial policy.
sentences.zh: 在此，CaT 还与从专家医生标注中学习相竞争，相对于初始策略带来了高达 +30% 的相对改进。

sentences.en: The framework extends naturally to verifiable rewards, matching the best existing baselines on MATH-500 in test-time RL and demonstrating 'drop-in' versatility across both types of domains.
sentences.zh: 该框架自然扩展到可验证奖励，在 MATH-500 上的测试时 RL 中匹敌最佳现有基线，并展示了在两类领域上的“即插即用”通用性。

title_en: Compute Where it Counts: Self Optimizing Language Models
title_zh: 把计算用在关键处：自优化语言模型

sentences.en: Efficient LLM inference research has largely focused on reducing the cost of each decoding step (e.g., using quantization, pruning, or sparse attention), typically applying a uniform computation budget to every generated token.
sentences.zh: 高效的 LLM 推理研究主要在降低每个解码步骤的成本（例如使用量化、剪枝或稀疏注意力），通常对每个生成的词元施加统一的计算预算。

sentences.en: In practice, token difficulty varies widely, so static compression can over-compute on easy steps and under-compute on hard ones.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，词元难度差异很大，因此静态压缩可能在简单步骤上过度计算，而在困难步骤上计算不足。

sentences.en: We study \emph{dynamic budget allocation} for autoregressive decoding: learning how much computation to spend \emph{per token} from within a single model.
sentences.zh: 我们研究自回归解码的*动态预算分配*：在单一模型内部学习每个*词元*应花费多少计算。

sentences.en: Self-Optimizing Language Models (SOL) pair a frozen LLM with a lightweight policy network that reads the LLM hidden state and selects a discrete \emph{efficiency action} at each decode step.
sentences.zh: 自优化语言模型（SOL）将冻结的 LLM 与一个轻量级策略网络配对，后者读取 LLM 的隐藏状态，并在每个解码步骤选择一个离散的*效率动作*。

sentences.en: Actions can jointly control (i) token-level attention sparsity, (ii) structured activation pruning in the MLP, and (iii) activation quantization bit-width, while leaving the base model weights unchanged.
sentences.zh: 这些动作可以联合控制（i）词元级注意力稀疏性，（ii）MLP 中的结构化激活剪枝，以及（iii）激活量化位宽，同时保持基础模型权重不变。

sentences.en: We train the policy with group-relative policy optimization on teacher-forced episodes: the token sequence is fixed, while we sample multiple compute schedules (i.e., “counterfactual” schedules that vary only the efficiency actions for the same token path) and compare their likelihoods under the same supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们使用教师强制的 episode 上的组相对策略优化来训练策略：词元序列是固定的，同时我们采样多个计算调度（即仅对同一词元路径变化效率动作的“反事实”调度），并在相同监督下比较它们的似然。

sentences.en: Our reward trades off language‑model quality against soft penalties that encourage episode‑average budget usage to match a requested target.
sentences.zh: 我们的奖励在语言模型质量与鼓励 episode 平均预算使用匹配所请求目标的软惩罚之间进行权衡。

sentences.en: Across model variants and compute regimes, SOL improves quality at matched budget over static allocation and strong random schedule search, offering a complementary axis for inference‑efficiency optimization.
sentences.zh: 跨模型变体与计算情境，SOL 在匹配预算下相对于静态分配与强随机调度搜索提升了质量，为推理效率优化提供了一个互补的轴。

sentences.en: SOL discovers a better quality-efficiency pareto-front across all our experiments and improves MMLU accuracy by up to 7.3\% over uniform budget allocation strategies.
sentences.zh: SOL 在我们所有实验中发现了一个更优的质量-效率 Pareto 前沿，并相对于均匀预算分配策略将 MMLU 精度提升了高达 7.3\%。

sentences.en: \href{https://github.com/akhauriyash/SOL}
sentences.zh: \href{https://github.com/akhauriyash/SOL}

title_en: Concept Concentration for Faithful Representation Intervention
title_zh: 通过概念集中实现忠实表征干预

sentences.en: Representation intervention aims to locate and modify the representations that encode the underlying concepts in Large Language Models (LLMs) to elicit the aligned and expected behaviors.
sentences.zh: 表示干预旨在定位并修改大语言模型（LLM）中编码底层概念的表示，以引出对齐且符合预期的行为。

sentences.en: Despite the empirical success, it has never been examined whether one could locate the faithful concepts for intervention.
sentences.zh: 尽管在经验上取得成功，但从未考察过人们能否定位到用于干预的忠实概念。

sentences.en: In this work, we explore the question in safety alignment.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们在安全对齐中探索这一问题。

sentences.en: If the interventions are faithful, the intervened LLMs should erase the harmful concepts and be robust to both in-distribution adversarial prompts and the \textit{out-of-distribution} (OOD) jailbreaks.
sentences.zh: 如果干预是忠实的，被干预的 LLM 应当擦除有害概念，并对分布内的对抗性提示以及\textit{out-of-distribution}（OOD）越狱都具有稳健性。

sentences.en: While it is feasible to erase harmful concepts without degrading the benign utility of LLMs in linear settings, we show that it is \textit{infeasible} in the general non-linear setting.
sentences.zh: 虽然在线性设定中，在不损害 LLM 良性效用的情况下擦除有害概念是可行的，但我们表明在一般的非线性设定中这是*不可行的*。

sentences.en: To tackle the issue, we propose \texttt{Concept Concentration} (\texttt{COCA}). \texttt{COCA} refactors the training data with an explicit reasoning process, which first identifies the potential unsafe concepts and then decides the responses.
sentences.zh: 为攻克这一问题，我们提出 \texttt{Concept Concentration}（\texttt{COCA}）。\texttt{COCA} 以显式的推理过程重构训练数据：它首先识别潜在的不安全概念，然后决定响应。

sentences.en: Essentially, \texttt{COCA} simplifies the decision boundary between harmful and benign representations, enabling more effective linear erasure.
sentences.zh: 本质上，\texttt{COCA} 简化了有害表示与良性表示的决策边界，使更有效的线性擦除成为可能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments with multiple representation intervention methods and model architectures demonstrate that \texttt{COCA} significantly reduces both in-distribution and OOD jailbreak success rates, and meanwhile maintaining strong performance on regular tasks such as math and code generation.
sentences.zh: 使用多种表示干预方法与模型架构的大量实验表明，\texttt{COCA} 显著降低了分布内与 OOD 越狱成功率，同时保持数学与代码生成等常规任务上的强劲性能。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/tmlr-group/COCA}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码公开于：\url{https://github.com/tmlr-group/COCA}。

title_en: Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering
title_zh: 概念异质性感知的表征引导

sentences.en: Representation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by intervening on internal activations at inference time.
sentences.zh: 表示引导通过在推理时干预内部激活，提供了一种控制大语言模型（LLM）行为的轻量机制。

sentences.en: Most existing methods rely on a single global steering direction, typically obtained via difference-in-means over contrastive datasets.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法依赖单一的全局引导方向，通常通过对对比数据集上的均值差获得。

sentences.en: This approach implicitly assumes that the target concept is homogeneously represented across the embedding space.
sentences.zh: 这种方法隐式地假设目标概念在嵌入空间中被同质地表示。

sentences.en: In practice, however, LLM representations can be highly non-homogeneous, exhibiting clustered, context-dependent structure, which renders global steering directions brittle.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，LLM 的表示可能高度非同质，表现出聚簇的、依赖上下文的结构，这使得全局引导方向变得脆弱。

sentences.en: In this work, we view representation steering through the lens of optimal transport (OT), noting that standard difference-in-means steering implicitly corresponds to the OT map between two identical distributions with differing first moments, yielding a global translation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从最优传输（OT）的视角审视表示引导，注意到标准的均值差引导隐式地对应于一阶矩不同的两个相同分布之间的 OT 映射，从而产生一个全局平移。

sentences.en: To relax this restrictive assumption, we theoretically model source and target representations as Gaussian mixture models and formulate steering as a discrete OT problem between semantic latent clusters.
sentences.zh: 为放宽这一限制性假设，我们在理论上将源与目标表示建模为高斯混合模型，并将引导表述为语义潜在聚类之间的离散 OT 问题。

sentences.en: From the resulting transport plan, we derive an explicit, input-dependent steering map via barycentric projection, producing a smooth, kernel-weighted combination of cluster-level shifts.
sentences.zh: 从由此得到的传输计划中，我们通过重心投影导出一个显式的、依赖输入的引导映射，产生簇级偏移的光滑、核加权组合。

sentences.en: We term this method Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering (CHaRS).
sentences.zh: 我们将这一方法称为概念异构性感知的表示引导（CHaRS）。

sentences.en: Through numerous experimental settings, we show that CHaRS yields more effective behavioral control than global steering.
sentences.zh: 通过众多实验设定，我们表明 CHaRS 比全局引导提供更有效的行为控制。

sentences.en: The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lazizcodes/CHaRS.
sentences.zh: 代码公开于 https://github.com/lazizcodes/CHaRS。

title_en: Concept Removal for Frontier Image Generative Models
title_zh: 前沿图像生成模型的概念移除

sentences.en: Image generative models are trained on massive, largely uncurated internet-scale datasets that contain undesirable visual concepts.
sentences.zh: 图像生成模型在海量、基本未经过精选的互联网规模数据集上训练，其中包含不良的视觉概念。

sentences.en: Efficiently removing such concepts from the model generations without degrading the quality of output images remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 在不降低输出图像质量的情况下高效地从模型生成中移除此类概念，仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: We introduce a novel concept removal method for frontier diffusion and image autoregressive models, such as, SD3.5, Flux, and Infinity.
sentences.zh: 我们为 SD3.5、Flux 与 Infinity 等前沿扩散与图像自回归模型引入一种新颖的概念移除方法。

sentences.en: Our intervention replaces the internal bottleneck layer present in all these modern models with a transcoder that is trained to replicate the original layer while structuring it into distinct activation features.
sentences.zh: 我们的干预方法将所有这些现代模型中都存在的内部瓶颈层替换为一个转换器（transcoder），该转换器经过训练以复现原层，同时将其结构化为截然不同的激活特征。

sentences.en: This in‑place substitution creates an integrated filter through which concept‑specific signals can be selectively disabled while preserving the rest of the model’s behavior.
sentences.zh: 这种原地替换创建一个集成滤波器，通过它可以在保持模型其余行为的同时选择性地禁用特定概念的信号。

sentences.en: Since the intervention modifies the model backbone rather than attaching an external component, it remains persistent under white‑box access.
sentences.zh: 由于该干预修改的是模型主干而非附加外部组件，它在白盒访问下仍然保持持久。

sentences.en: Empirically, the approach achieves state‑of‑the‑art concept removal performance across modern diffusion and autoregressive models, maintains visual generation quality, provides robustness against adversarial prompts, and supports sequential removal of diverse concepts.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，该方法在现代扩散与自回归模型上取得了最先进的概念移除性能，保持了视觉生成质量，提供了对对抗性提示的稳健性，并支持顺序移除多样概念。

sentences.en: This positions our method as a practical approach for concept removal in frontier image generative models.
sentences.zh: 这使我们的方法成为前沿图像生成模型中概念移除的一种实用方案。

title_en: Concept-Guided Tokenization: Closing the Gap Between Reconstruction and Generation
title_zh: 概念引导的词元化：弥合重建与生成的差距

sentences.en: Recent advances in image generation have been largely driven by image tokenization, which compresses raw pixels into compact latent representations.
sentences.zh: 图像生成的最新进展很大程度上由图像词元化驱动，它将原始像素压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。

sentences.en: While existing tokenizers excel at preserving low-level visual details through reconstruction-based training, they often lack explicit semantic guidance, which limits their ability to capture semantically structured representations and thus hinders their performance on downstream tasks like image generation.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的词元化器通过基于重建的训练在保留底层视觉细节方面表现出色，但它们往往缺乏显式的语义引导，这限制了它们捕获语义结构化表示的能力，从而阻碍了它们在图像生成等下游任务上的性能。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel tokenization framework that incorporates high-level semantics through two key innovations: (1) a text-integrated encoder that jointly processes images and textual descriptions to produce semantically enriched latent representations, and (2) a concept-guided training objective that leverages sparse autoencoders to decompose pre-trained vision-language model features to a semantic concept space, employing sparse and disentangled concept indices for guidance.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出一种新颖的词元化框架，通过两项关键创新融入高层语义：（1）一个文本集成编码器，它联合处理图像与文本描述以产生语义丰富的潜在表示；以及（2）一个概念引导的训练目标，它利用稀疏自编码器将预训练的视觉-语言模型特征分解为语义概念空间，采用稀疏且解耦的概念索引进行引导。

sentences.en: Our approach achieves strong alignment with semantic concepts, maintaining high reconstruction fidelity with an rFID of 1.39 on ImageNet, while achieving a gFID of 2.65 on the class-conditional image generation task and 10.73 on the text-to-image generation task.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法与语义概念实现了强对齐，在 ImageNet 上以 1.39 的 rFID 保持高重建保真度，同时在类条件图像生成任务上取得 2.65 的 gFID，在文生图任务上取得 10.73 的 gFID。

sentences.en: By infusing high-level semantic structures into low-level visual fidelity, our method bridges the reconstruction-generation divide and drives generative modeling as a powerful foundation.
sentences.zh: 通过将高层语义结构注入低层视觉保真度，我们的方法弥合了重建-生成的分界，并将生成建模推向一个强大的基础。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/hustyyq/ConceptTok
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/hustyyq/ConceptTok 获取。
