title_en: ConceptMoE: Adaptive Token-to-Concept Compression for Implicit Compute Allocation
title_zh: ConceptMoE：通过自适应词元到概念压缩实现隐式计算分配

sentences.en: Large language models allocate uniform computation across all tokens, ignoring that some sequences are trivially predictable while others require deep reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型对所有词元分配统一的计算，忽略了有些序列是平凡可预测的，而另一些则需要深度推理。

sentences.en: We introduce ConceptMoE, which dynamically merges semantically similar tokens into concepts through learnable chunking at target compression ratio $R$.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ConceptMoE，它通过可学习的分块，以目标压缩比 $R$ 将语义相似的词元动态合并为概念。

sentences.en: The MoE architecture enables controlled evaluation: reallocating saved computation to match baseline FLOPs and parameters isolates genuine architectural benefits.
sentences.zh: MoE 架构实现了受控的评估：重新分配节省的计算以匹配基线 FLOPs 与参数，从而隔离出真正的架构益处。

sentences.en: ConceptMoE consistently outperforms standard MoE, achieving +0.9 points on language pretraining, +2.3 on long context, and +0.6 on multimodal tasks.
sentences.zh: ConceptMoE 一致地优于标准 MoE，在语言预训练上取得 +0.9 分，长上下文上 +2.3 分，多模态任务上 +0.6 分。

sentences.en: Continual training conversion with layer looping gains +5.5 points.
sentences.zh: 带层循环的持续训练转换获得 +5.5 分。

sentences.en: Beyond performance, at $R=2$, ConceptMoE reduces attention computation by $R^2\times$ and KV cache by $R\times$, delivering prefill speedups up to 175\% and decoding speedups up to 117\%.
sentences.zh: 除性能之外，在 $R=2$ 时，ConceptMoE 将注意力计算减少了 $R^2\times$，KV 缓存减少了 $R\times$，带来高达 175\% 的预填充加速与高达 117\% 的解码加速。

sentences.en: The minimal architectural changes enable straightforward integration, demonstrating that adaptive concept-level processing fundamentally improves LLM effectiveness and efficiency.
sentences.zh: 极小的架构改动使其能够轻松集成，表明自适应的概念级处理从根本上提升了 LLM 的有效性与效率。

title_en: CONCUR: High-Throughput Agentic Batch Inference of LLM via Congestion-Based Concurrency Control
title_zh: CONCUR：通过基于拥塞的并发控制实现高吞吐智能体式大语言模型批量推理

sentences.en: Batch inference for agentic workloads stresses the GPU key–value (KV) cache in a sustained and cumulative manner, often causing severe throughput degradation well before memory capacity is exhausted.
sentences.zh: 面向智能体工作负载的批量推理会以持续且累积的方式给 GPU 键-值（KV）缓存带来压力，常常在内存容量耗尽之前就造成严重的吞吐量退化。

sentences.en: We identify this phenomenon as middle-phase thrashing, a previously under-characterized pathology in which cache efficiency collapses as long-lived agents accumulate state over time.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一现象识别为中阶段抖动（middle-phase thrashing），这是一种此前未被充分表征的病理现象，其中随着长生命周期的智能体随时间积累状态，缓存效率会崩溃。

sentences.en: We argue that mitigating this pathology requires moving beyond reactive, request-level cache management to proactive, agent-level admission control.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，缓解这一病理需要超越反应式的、请求级的缓存管理，转向主动的、智能体级的准入控制。

sentences.en: Drawing inspiration from congestion control in distributed systems, we view the KV cache as a shared resource whose efficient utilization depends on feedback-driven regulation.
sentences.zh: 受到分布式系统中拥塞控制的启发，我们将 KV 缓存视为一种共享资源，其高效利用取决于反馈驱动的调节。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we present CONCUR, a lightweight control layer that regulates agent admission to bound aggregate cache pressure while preserving execution continuity.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 CONCUR，一个轻量级控制层，它调节智能体准入以约束总缓存压力，同时保持执行连续性。

sentences.en: CONCUR adapts a cache-aware control algorithm to dynamically adjust the number of active agents using runtime cache signals.
sentences.zh: CONCUR 适配了一种缓存感知的控制算法，利用运行时缓存信号动态调整活跃智能体的数量。

sentences.en: Across large models and real-world agent workloads, CONCUR prevents middle-phase thrashing and improves batch inference throughput by up to 4.09× on Qwen3-32B and 1.90× on DeepSeek-V3, while remaining compatible with existing LLM serving systems.
sentences.zh: 在大模型与真实世界的智能体工作负载上，CONCUR 阻止了中阶段抖动，并在 Qwen3-32B 上将批量推理吞吐量提升高达 4.09 倍，在 DeepSeek-V3 上提升 1.90 倍，同时保持与现有 LLM 服务系统的兼容性。

title_en: Condition Number Based Low-Bit Quantization for Image Super-Resolution
title_zh: 用于图像超分辨率的基于条件数的低比特量化

sentences.en: Low-bit model quantization for image super-resolution (SR) is a longstanding task that is renowned for its surprising compression and acceleration ability.
sentences.zh: 用于图像超分辨率（SR）的低位模型量化是一项长期任务，以其惊人的压缩与加速能力而闻名。

sentences.en: However, accuracy degradation is inevitable when compressing the full-precision (FP) model to ultra-low bit widths ($2\sim4$ bits).
sentences.zh: 然而，将全精度（FP）模型压缩到超低位宽（$2\sim4$ 位）时，精度下降是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Experimentally, we observe that the degradation of quantization is mainly attributed to the quantization of activation instead of model weights.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们观察到量化的退化主要归因于激活的量化，而非模型权重。

sentences.en: Considering that the activation quantization error is hard to minimize, minimizing the impact of the error emerges as a good choice, which is described by the condition number.
sentences.zh: 考虑到激活量化误差难以最小化，最小化该误差的影响便成为一个好的选择，这可以用条件数来描述。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose CondiQuant, a condition number-based low-bit post-training quantization for image super-resolution.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出 CondiQuant，一种基于条件数的图像超分辨率低位训练后量化方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, we formulate the quantization error of activation as the condition number of weight metrics.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将激活的量化误差表述为权重度量的条件数。

sentences.en: By decoupling the representation ability and the quantization sensitivity, we design an efficient proximal gradient descent algorithm to iteratively minimize the condition number and maintain the output.
sentences.zh: 通过解耦表示能力与量化敏感性，我们设计了一种高效的近端梯度下降算法，以迭代地最小化条件数并保持输出。

sentences.en: With comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that CondiQuant outperforms existing state-of-the-art post-training quantization methods in accuracy without computation overhead and gains the theoretically optimal compression ratio in model parameters.
sentences.zh: 通过全面的实验，我们证明 CondiQuant 在精度上优于现有最先进的训练后量化方法而不增加计算开销，并在模型参数上获得理论最优的压缩比。

sentences.en: Our code will be released soon.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将很快发布。

title_en: Condition-Aware Graph Flow Matching for Modeling the Distributions of Complex Fluid Systems
title_zh: 条件感知图流匹配：建模复杂流体系统的分布

sentences.en: Accurately modeling the full distributions of possible states is crucial for understanding statistical properties and enabling reliable predictions in complex fluid systems.
sentences.zh: 准确建模可能状态的完整分布，对理解复杂流体系统中的统计性质并实现可靠预测至关重要。

sentences.en: Recently, diffusion models and flow matching have shown promise in these tasks.
sentences.zh: 近来，扩散模型与流匹配在这些任务中展现出前景。

sentences.en: However, they remain limited in uncovering the general principles of systems from multiple short trajectories across the condition space.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们在从跨条件空间的多个短轨迹中揭示系统的一般原理方面仍然受限。

sentences.en: In addition, they exhibit inferior adaptability to large irregular geometries, particularly in regions with sharp gradients.
sentences.zh: 此外，它们对大的不规则几何形状适应较差，尤其是在具有急剧梯度的区域。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a condition-aware graph flow matching (CGFM) method that combines condition-aware flow matching with a hierarchical graph structure to learn the full distributions of fluid systems from incomplete training data.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种条件感知图流匹配（CGFM）方法，它将条件感知的流匹配与层次化图结构相结合，从不完整的训练数据中学习流体系统的完整分布。

sentences.en: Specifically, CGFM constructs a flow enabling smooth interpolation across physical conditions and parameterizes the graph-conditioned vector field through HieraGraphNet.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CGFM 构建一个能够跨物理条件平滑插值的流，并通过 HieraGraphNet 对图条件的向量场进行参数化。

sentences.en: HieraGraphNet performs message passing across multilevel graphs to capture multi-scale dynamics and facilitate long-range information interactions in fluid systems.
sentences.zh: HieraGraphNet 跨多级图执行消息传递，以捕获多尺度动力学，并促进流体系统中的长程信息交互。

sentences.en: Moreover, we introduce a topology- and geometry-aware graph coarsening scheme that incorporates topological connectivity and local geometric density to construct reliable coarse graphs.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一种拓扑与几何感知的图粗化方案，它结合拓扑连通性与局部几何密度来构建可靠的粗图。

sentences.en: We validate the effectiveness of CGFM on three canonical scenarios across both 2D and 3D dynamics, which demonstrate its superior performance compared with that of state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在 2D 与 3D 动力学中的三个典型场景上验证了 CGFM 的有效性，结果表明其性能优于最先进的基线。

title_en: Conditional Clifford-Steerable CNNs for PDE Modeling
title_zh: 用于偏微分方程建模的条件 Clifford 可转向卷积神经网络

sentences.en: We introduce Conditional Clifford-Steerable CNNs (C-CSCNNs), a unified framework that incorporates equivariance to arbitrary pseudo-Euclidean groups and significantly improves the expressivity of standard CSCNNs.
sentences.zh: 我们引入条件 Clifford-可转向 CNN（C-CSCNN），一个将任意伪欧几里得群的等变性纳入其中的统一框架，并显著提升了标准 CSCNN 的表达力。

sentences.en: We show that the kernel basis of the standard formulation is incomplete, limiting model capacity.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，标准表述的核基是不完备的，限制了模型的容量。

sentences.en: To address this, we augment the kernels with equivariant representations of the input feature field.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们以输入特征场的等变表示来增广核。

sentences.en: We derive the equivariance constraint for these input-dependent kernels and show how it can be solved efficiently via implicit parameterization.
sentences.zh: 我们为这些依赖输入的核推导了等变约束，并展示了如何通过隐式参数化高效地求解它。

sentences.en: We empirically validate on multiple PDE forecasting tasks, including fluid dynamics and relativistic electrodynamics, where our method consistently outperforms standard CSCNNs and performs on par with state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在包括流体动力学与相对论电动力学在内的多个 PDE 预测任务上进行了实证验证，我们的方法在这些任务上一致地优于标准 CSCNN，并与最先进的基线性能相当。

title_en: Conditional Coverage Diagnostics for Conformal Prediction
title_zh: 共形预测的条件覆盖率诊断

sentences.en: Evaluating conditional coverage remains one of the most persistent challenges in assessing the reliability of predictive systems.
sentences.zh: 评估条件覆盖仍然是评估预测系统可靠性的最持久挑战之一。

sentences.en: Although conformal methods can give guarantees on marginal coverage, no method can guarantee to produce sets with correct conditional coverage, leaving practitioners without a clear way to interpret local deviations.
sentences.zh: 虽然保形方法可以给出边际覆盖的保证，但没有任何方法能够保证产生具有正确条件覆盖的集合，使从业者在解释局部偏差时缺乏明确途径。

sentences.en: To overcome sample-inefficiency and overfitting issues of existing metrics, we cast conditional coverage estimation as a classification problem.
sentences.zh: 为克服现有指标的样本低效与过拟合问题，我们将条件覆盖估计转化为一个分类问题。

sentences.en: Conditional coverage is violated if and only if some classifier can achieve lower risk than the target coverage.
sentences.zh: 当且仅当某个分类器能够实现低于目标覆盖风险时，条件覆盖才被违反。

sentences.en: Through the choice of a (proper) loss function, the resulting risk difference gives a conservative estimate of natural miscoverage measures such as L1 and L2 distance, and can even separate the effects of over- and under-coverage, as well as handle non-constant target coverages.
sentences.zh: 通过选择（恰当的）损失函数，由此产生的风险差给出了天然覆盖率不一致度量（例如 L1 与 L2 距离）的保守估计，甚至可以分离过度覆盖与覆盖不足的影响，并且能够处理非恒定的目标覆盖率。

sentences.en: We call the resulting family of metrics excess risk of the target coverage (ERT).
sentences.zh: 我们将由此产生的指标族称为目标覆盖的额外风险（ERT）。

sentences.en: We show experimentally that the use of modern classifiers provides much higher statistical power than simple classifiers underlying established metrics like CovGap.
sentences.zh: 我们在实验上表明，使用现代分类器提供的统计功效远高于底层指标（如 CovGap）所基于的简单分类器。

sentences.en: Additionally, we use our metric to benchmark different conformal prediction methods.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们使用我们的指标对不同保形预测方法进行基准测试。

sentences.en: Finally, we release an open-source package for ERT as well as previous conditional coverage metrics.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们发布了一个面向 ERT 以及先前条件覆盖指标的开源软件包。

sentences.en: Together, these contributions provide a new lens for understanding, diagnosing, and improving the conditional reliability of predictive systems.
sentences.zh: 这些贡献共同为理解、诊断与改进预测系统的条件可靠性提供了一个新的视角。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Conditional Diffusion Sampling
title_zh: 条件扩散采样

sentences.en: Sampling from unnormalized multimodal distributions with limited density evaluations remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning and natural sciences.
sentences.zh: 在密度评估数量有限的情况下从未归一化多峰分布采样，仍然是机器学习与自然科学中的一个根本挑战。

sentences.en: Successful approaches construct a bridge between a tractable reference and the target distribution.
sentences.zh: 成功的方法在易于处理的参考分布与目标分布之间构建一座桥梁。

sentences.en: Parallel Tempering (PT) serves as the gold standard, while recent diffusion-based approaches offer a continuous alternative at the cost of neural training.
sentences.zh: 并行退火（PT）是黄金标准，而近期基于扩散的方法以神经训练为代价提供了一种连续替代方案。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce Conditional Diffusion Sampling (CDS), a framework that combines these two paradigms.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入条件扩散采样（CDS），一个将这两种范式结合起来的框架。

sentences.en: To this end, we derive Conditional Interpolants, a class of stochastic processes whose transport dynamics are governed by an exact, closed-form stochastic differential equation (SDE), requiring no neural approximation.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们推导了条件插值子（Conditional Interpolants），一类其输运动力学由一个精确的、闭式的随机微分方程（SDE）支配的随机过程，不需要神经近似。

sentences.en: Although these dynamics require sampling from a non-trivial initialization distribution, we show both theoretically and empirically that the cost of this initialization diminishes for sufficiently short diffusion times.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些动力学需要从一个非平凡的初始化分布中采样，但我们在理论上与经验上都表明，对于足够短的扩散时间，该初始化的成本会降低。

sentences.en: CDS leverages this by a two-stage procedure: (1) PT is used to efficiently sample the initial distribution, and then (2) samples are transported via the transport SDE.
sentences.zh: CDS 通过一个两阶段流程利用这一点：（1）使用 PT 高效地采样初始分布，然后（2）通过输运 SDE 运输样本。

sentences.en: This combination couples the robust global exploration of PT with efficient local transport.
sentences.zh: 这种组合将 PT 稳健的全局探索与高效的局部输运耦合起来。

sentences.en: Experiments suggest that CDS has the potential to achieve a superior trade-off between sample quality and density evaluation cost compared to state-of-the-art samplers.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，与最先进的采样器相比，CDS 有潜力在样本质量与密度评估成本之间实现更优的权衡。

title_en: Conditional Distributional Treatment Effects: Doubly Robust Estimation and Testing
title_zh: 条件分布处理效应：双重鲁棒估计与检验

sentences.en: Beyond conditional average treatment effects, treatments may impact the entire outcome distribution in covariate-dependent ways, for example, by altering the variance or tail risks for specific subpopulations.
sentences.zh: 除了条件平均处理效应之外，处理还可能以依赖协变量的方式影响整个结果分布，例如通过改变特定亚群的方差或尾部风险。

sentences.en: We propose a novel estimand to capture such conditional distributional treatment effects, and develop a doubly robust estimator that is minimax optimal in the local asymptotic sense.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新的估计目标来捕获此类条件分布处理效应，并开发一个双重稳健估计器，它在局部渐近意义上是极小极大最优的。

sentences.en: Using this, we develop a test for the global homogeneity of conditional potential outcome distributions that accommodates discrepancies beyond the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), has provably valid type 1 error, and is consistent against fixed alternatives---the first test, to our knowledge, with such guarantees in this setting.
sentences.zh: 利用这一点，我们开发了一个针对条件潜在结果分布全局同质性的检验，它能够容纳超出最大均值差异（MMD）的差异，具有可证明有效的第一类错误，并且对固定备择假设一致——据我们所知，这是该设定中第一个具有此类保证的检验。

sentences.en: We then provide a test that aggregates evidence across a grid of kernel-bandwidth choices.
sentences.zh: 然后我们提供一个跨核带宽选择网格聚合证据的检验。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we derive exact closed-form expressions for two natural discrepancies (including the MMD), and provide a computationally efficient, permutation-free algorithm for our test.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为两种自然差异（包括 MMD）推导了精确的闭式表达式，并为我们的检验提供了一种计算高效、免置换的算法。

title_en: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Assumptions, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
title_zh: DPO 与 RLHF 的条件等价性：假设、失效模式与可证明对齐

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的一种流行替代方案，以更简单的实现提供了理论等价性。

sentences.en: We prove this equivalence is _conditional_ rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这种等价性是*有条件的*而非普遍的，它依赖于一个在实践中经常被违反的隐式假设：RLHF 最优策略必须偏好人类偏好的响应。

sentences.en: When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes _relative advantage_ over the reference policy rather than _absolute alignment_ with human preferences, leading to pathological convergence where policies decrease DPO loss while preferring dispreferred responses.
sentences.zh: 当这一假设失败时，DPO 优化的是相对于参考策略的*相对优势*，而非与人类偏好的*绝对对齐*，从而导致病态收敛，即策略降低 DPO 损失却偏好不受欢迎的响应。

sentences.en: We characterize when this assumption is violated, show the existence of an undesirable solution space, and prove that DPO and RLHF optimize fundamentally different objectives in such cases.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了这一假设何时被违反，证明了不良解空间的存在性，并证明在此类情况下 DPO 与 RLHF 优化的是根本不同的目标。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Constrained Preference Optimization (CPO), augmenting RLHF with constraints for provable alignment.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入约束偏好优化（CPO），以可证明对齐的约束来增强 RLHF。

sentences.en: We further provide a geometric interpretation through soft margin ranking, revealing DPO implements margin ranking with potentially negative targets.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过软间隔排序提供了一个几何解释，揭示 DPO 实现的是带潜在负目标的间隔排序。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis establishes when DPOs' guarantees hold and provides solutions preserving simplicity with provable alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析确立了 DPO 的保证在何时成立，并提供了在保持简单性的同时实现可证明对齐的解决方案。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CPO achieves state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的全面实验表明，CPO 取得了最先进的性能。

authors.name: Wei Xue
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Conditional KRR: Injecting Unpenalized Features into Kernel Methods with Applications to Kernel Thresholding
title_zh: 条件核岭回归：向核方法注入不受惩罚的特征及其在核阈值化中的应用

sentences.en: Conditionally positive definite (CPD) kernels are defined with respect to a function class $\mathcal{F}$.
sentences.zh: 条件正定（CPD）核是相对于一个函数类 $\mathcal{F}$ 定义的。

sentences.en: It is well known that such a kernel $K$ is associated with its native space (defined analogously to an RKHS), which in turn gives rise to a learning method --- called conditional kernel ridge regression (conditional KRR) due to its analogy with KRR --- where the estimated regression function is penalized by the square of its native space norm.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，此类核 $K$ 与其原生空间（以与 RKHS 类似的方式定义）相关联，后者反过来产生一种学习方法——由于与 KRR 的类比而被称为条件核岭回归（conditional KRR）——其中估计出的回归函数以其原生空间范数的平方进行惩罚。

sentences.en: This method is of interest because it can be viewed as classical linear regression, with features specified by $\mathcal{F}$, followed by the application of standard KRR to the residual (unexplained) component of the target variable.
sentences.zh: 该方法之所以令人感兴趣，是因为它可以被视为经典的线性回归（其特征由 $\mathcal{F}$ 指定），随后对目标变量的残差（未解释）分量应用标准 KRR。

sentences.en: Methods of this type have recently attracted increasing attention.
sentences.zh: 此类方法近来引起了越来越多的关注。

sentences.en: We study the statistical properties of this method by reducing its behavior to that of KRR with another fixed kernel, called the residual kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将其行为归约为另一个固定核（称为残差核）的 KRR 行为来研究该方法的统计性质。

sentences.en: Our main theoretical result shows that such a reduction is indeed possible, at the cost of an additional term in the expected test risk, bounded by $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{N})$, where $N$ is the sample size and the hidden constant depends on the class $\mathcal{F}$ and the input distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要理论结果表明，这种归约确实是可能的，代价是在期望测试风险中出现一个额外项，它被 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{N})$ 界定，其中 N 是样本量，隐藏常数取决于类 $\mathcal{F}$ 与输入分布。

sentences.en: This reduction enables us to analyze conditional KRR in the case where $K$ is positive definite and $\mathcal{F}$ is given by the first $k$ principal eigenfunctions in the Mercer decomposition of $K$.
sentences.zh: 这一归约使我们能够在 $K$ 正定且 F 由 $K$ 的 Mercer 分解中前 $k$ 个主特征函数给出的情形下分析条件 KRR。

sentences.en: We also consider the setting where $\mathcal{F}$ consists of $k$ random features from a random feature representation of $K$.
sentences.zh: 我们还考虑 $\mathcal{F}$ 由 $K$ 的随机特征表示中的 $k$ 个随机特征组成的情形。

sentences.en: It turns out that these two settings are closely related.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这两种设定密切相关。

sentences.en: Both our theoretical analysis and experiments confirm that conditional KRR outperforms standard KRR in these cases whenever the $\mathcal{F}$-component of the regression function is more pronounced than the residual part.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析与实验都证实，只要回归函数的 $\mathcal{F}$-分量比残差部分更突出，条件 KRR 在这些情况下就会优于标准 KRR。

topic: General Machine Learning->Sequential, Network, and Time Series Modeling
title_en: Conditional Quantile Adjusted Conformal Prediction for Time Series
title_zh: 时间序列的条件分位数调整共形预测

sentences.en: Conformal prediction is challenging for time series with time-varying conditional distributions.
sentences.zh: 对于具有时变条件分布的时间序列，保形预测颇具挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing sequential conformal methods can yield volatile, non-nested prediction intervals due to noisy tail conditional quantile estimation and quantile crossing issue.
sentences.zh: 现有的序列保形方法会因噪声的尾部条件分位数估计与分位数交叉问题，产生多变、非嵌套的预测区间。

sentences.en: To overcome these challenges, we construct prediction intervals for time series via a novel method called Conditional Quantile Adjusted Conformal Prediction (CQACP), which stabilizes sequential conformal calibration by modeling the conditional quantile curve of nonconformity score.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们通过一种名为条件分位数调整保形预测（CQACP）的新方法为时间序列构建预测区间，它通过建模不一致分数的条件分位数曲线来稳定序列保形校准。

sentences.en: At each time step, CQACP evaluates a base conditional quantile learner on a grid of quantile levels and fits a Cornish--Fisher approximation parameterized by conditional moments of nonconformity score with monotonicity constraints.
sentences.zh: 在每个时间步，CQACP 在一个分位数水平网格上评估一个基础条件分位数学习器，并拟合一个由不一致分数的条件矩参数化的、带单调性约束的 Cornish-Fisher 近似。

sentences.en: Asymptotically, we prove the conditional validity of the prediction interval under serial dependence and show improved conditional quantile estimation accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在渐近上，我们证明了在序列依赖下预测区间的条件有效性，并展示了改进的条件分位数估计精度。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that CQACP maintains accurate coverage and produces smooth, narrow, and nested prediction intervals across different significance levels and prediction models.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，CQACP 在不同显著性水平与预测模型下保持了准确的覆盖率，并产生光滑、窄且嵌套的预测区间。

title_en: Conditionally Site-Independent Neural Evolution of Antibody Sequences
title_zh: 抗体序列的条件位点独立神经进化

sentences.en: Common deep learning approaches for antibody engineering focus on modeling the marginal distribution of sequences.
sentences.zh: 用于抗体工程的常见深度学习方法聚焦于对序列的边际分布建模。

sentences.en: By treating sequences as independent samples, however, these methods overlook affinity maturation as a rich and largely untapped source of information about the evolutionary process by which antibodies explore the underlying fitness landscape.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过将序列视为独立样本，这些方法忽视了亲和力成熟作为关于抗体探索底层适应度景观进化过程的信息的丰富且大部分未开发的来源。

sentences.en: In contrast, classical phylogenetic models explicitly represent evolutionary dynamics but lack the expressivity to capture complex epistatic interactions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，经典的系统发育模型显式地表示进化动力学，但缺乏捕获复杂上位性互作的表达力。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap with **CoSiNE**, a continuous-time Markov chain  parameterized by a deep neural network.
sentences.zh: 我们用 **CoSiNE** 弥合这一差距，它是一个由深度神经网络参数化的连续时间马尔可夫链。

sentences.en: Mathematically, we prove that CoSiNE provides a first-order approximation to the intractable sequential point mutation process, capturing epistatic effects with an error bound that is quadratic in branch length.
sentences.zh: 在数学上，我们证明 CoSiNE 为不可处理的序贯点突变过程提供了一阶近似，以随分支长度二次变化的误差界捕获上位性效应。

sentences.en: Empirically, CoSiNE outperforms state-of-the-art language models in zero-shot variant effect prediction by explicitly disentangling selection from context-dependent somatic hypermutation.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，CoSiNE 通过显式地将选择与依赖上下文的体细胞超突变分离开来，在零样本变异效应预测上优于最先进的语言模型。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce *Guided Gillespie*, a classifier-guided sampling scheme that steers CoSiNE at inference time, enabling efficient optimization of antibody binding affinity toward specific antigens.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入 *Guided Gillespie*，一种分类器引导的采样方案，它在推理时引导 CoSiNE，从而能够针对特定抗原高效地优化抗体结合亲和力。

authors.name: Jiarui Lu
authors.institution: Mila - Quebec AI Institute; Université de Montréal

title_en: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
title_zh: ConEx：通过概念感知归因生成人类可解释的显著性图

sentences.en: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness.
sentences.zh: 计算机视觉中的许多视觉解释方法凸显像素重要性，但难以将这些底层线索与语义有意义的概念联系起来，限制了它们的可解释性与可信度。

sentences.en: We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 我们引入基于概念的解释（ConEx），一个在显著性可视化与基于概念推理之间架起桥梁的新颖框架，同时提供忠实度与可解释性。

sentences.en: ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity.
sentences.zh: ConEx 自动发现类特定概念，并通过概念激活向量（CAV）表示它们，使用架构特定的掩码机制在无需人工监督的情况下学习，该机制减少了分割掩码引入的噪声，以增强概念纯净度。

sentences.en: ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction.
sentences.zh: ConEx 生成忠实的显著性图，揭示每个概念出现在图像中的位置以及它如何对预测作出贡献。

sentences.en: To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods.
sentences.zh: 为评估这些学习到的概念的可靠性，我们提出两个互补的度量——向量-概念匹配（VCM）与概念-类别匹配（CCM）——它们量化概念对齐，并能够与现有方法进行直接比较。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 跨多样设定的大量实验表明，ConEx 在忠实度、分割与概念质量基准上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，ConEx 推动该领域走向视觉模型中真正可解释且以概念为根据的解释。

title_en: Conf-Gen: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification for Generative Models
title_zh: Conf-Gen：生成模型的共形不确定性量化

sentences.en: Conformal prediction (CP) and its extension, conformal risk control (CRC), are established frameworks for quantifying uncertainty in supervised machine learning through formal guarantees.
sentences.zh: 保形预测（CP）及其扩展保形风险控制（CRC），是通过正式保证在监督式机器学习中量化不确定性的成熟框架。

sentences.en: However, recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) have been driven by unsupervised generative models, such as large language models (LLMs) and image generators, which are not directly compatible with CP or CRC.
sentences.zh: 然而，人工智能（AI）近来的突破是由无监督生成式模型（如大语言模型（LLM）与图像生成器）驱动的，它们与 CP 或 CRC 并不直接兼容。

sentences.en: In this work we introduce conformal generation (Conf-Gen), a general framework adapting CRC to generative tasks while relaxing its theoretical assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入保形生成（Conf-Gen），一个将 CRC 适配到生成式任务、同时放宽其理论假设的通用框架。

sentences.en: Conf-Gen unifies and generalizes previous attempts to apply CP to LLMs, and extends conformal methodology to entirely new domains.
sentences.zh: Conf-Gen 统一并推广了先前将 CP 应用于 LLM 的尝试，并将保形方法论扩展到全新的领域。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the flexibility of Conf-Gen through some novel applications, including obtaining conformal guarantees on: image generators producing non-memorized images, conversational AI systems having asked enough clarifying questions, and the output of AI agents being correct.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一些新颖的应用展示了 Conf-Gen 的灵活性，包括在如下方面获得保形保证：生成非记忆化图像的图像生成器、已提出足够澄清问题的对话式 AI 系统，以及 AI 智能体输出的正确性。

title_en: Confidence is Not Universal: Task-Dependent Calibration and Emergent Behavior in LLMs
title_zh: 置信度并非普适：大语言模型中依赖任务的校准与涌现行为

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support human decision-making, rendering human-interpretable confidence essential.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益支持人类决策，使人类可解释的置信度变得至关重要。

sentences.en: However, it remains unclear whether verbalized confidence calibration generalizes across heterogeneous tasks without degrading accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，口头化置信度校准能否在异质任务间泛化且不降低精度，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We show that universal confidence calibration fails.
sentences.zh: 我们表明通用的置信度校准是失败的。

sentences.en: Across diverse benchmarks, we identify two incompatible task families with distinct confidence semantics.
sentences.zh: 跨多样基准，我们识别出两个具有不同置信度语义的不相容任务族。

sentences.en: In reasoning-centric tasks, confidence supervision transfers within the family, often improving calibration while preserving or even improving accuracy, and induces emergent behaviors such as confidence-dependent reasoning length and self-verification.
sentences.zh: 在以推理为中心的任务中，置信度监督在族内迁移，常常在保持甚至提升精度的同时改进校准，并诱导出诸如依赖置信度的推理长度与自我验证等涌现行为。

sentences.en: Retrieval- and copy-oriented tasks also exhibit within-family transfer, but fail to generalize to reasoning tasks, with cross-family supervision degrading both calibration and accuracy.
sentences.zh: 检索导向与复制导向的任务也表现出族内迁移，但无法泛化到推理任务，此时跨族监督会使校准与精度都退化。

sentences.en: Motivated by this finding, we disentangle confidence into reasoning uncertainty and evidence localization uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 受这一发现的启发，我们将置信度分解为推理不确定性与证据定位不确定性。

sentences.en: This simple decomposition restores cross-family generalization using supervised fine-tuning alone, suggesting that effective confidence alignment requires task-aware semantics rather than a universal scalar notion.
sentences.zh: 这种简单的分解仅用监督微调就恢复了跨族泛化，表明有效的置信度对齐需要任务感知的语义，而非通用的标量概念。

authors.name: Yegon Kim
authors.institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology

title_en: Configurable Reward Model for Balanced Safety Alignment
title_zh: 用于平衡安全对齐的可配置奖励模型

sentences.en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to heterogeneous and rapidly evolving safety requirements remains a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）对齐到异构且快速演进的安全要求，仍然是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Existing instruction-tuned LLMs and standalone safety classifiers often fail to generalize to new safety configurations, motivating the need for Reward Models (RMs) that are explicitly configurable to changing specifications.
sentences.zh: 现有的指令微调 LLM 与独立的安全分类器往往无法泛化到新的安全配置，这促使了对可显式配置到变化规范的奖励模型（RM）的需求。

sentences.en: We introduce the Configurable Safety Reward Model (CSRM), which is jointly optimized for calibrated safety compliance and reward modeling.
sentences.zh: 我们引入可配置安全奖励模型（CSRM），它被联合优化以实现校准的安全合规与奖励建模。

sentences.en: Our approach is supported by configuration-targeted data augmentation that enforces instruction adherence while preserving relative severity structure.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法由针对配置的数据增强所支撑，它在保持相对严重性结构的同时强制指令遵从性。

sentences.en: The resulting RM is sensitive to fine-grained safety configurations and conversational nuances, substantially improving generalization to previously unseen safety configurations.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的 RM 对细粒度的安全配置与会话细微差别高度敏感，大幅改进了对先前未见安全配置的泛化。

sentences.en: CSRM achieves state-of-the-art performance on recent configurable safety benchmarks, including CoSApien (94.6\% F1) and DynaBench (75.8\% F1), without requiring additional human annotation.
sentences.zh: CSRM 在最近的可配置安全基准上取得了最先进的性能，包括 CoSApien（94.6\% F1）与 DynaBench（75.8\% F1），而无需额外的人工标注。

sentences.en: When used for downstream safety alignment, CSRM yields LLMs with a significantly improved helpfulness–safety tradeoff compared to existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 当用于下游安全对齐时，与现有基线相比，CSRM 产生了显著性改进的实用性-安全性权衡的 LLM。

title_en: Conflict-Aware Adaptive Alignment for LLM Hallucination Mitigation
title_zh: 用于缓解大语言模型幻觉的冲突感知自适应对齐

sentences.en: Despite strong performance, large language models (LLMs) still suffer from hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 尽管性能强劲，大语言模型（LLM）仍然饱受幻觉之苦。

sentences.en: Most existing mitigation methods operate at inference time, without addressing the alignment limitation: LLMs are not trained to recognize their own lack of knowledge, and therefore tend to generate plausible responses even when the required knowledge is missing.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的缓解方法在推理时运作，而没有解决对齐的局限：LLM 未被训练来识别自己缺乏知识，因此即便所需知识缺失时也倾向于生成看似合理的响应。

sentences.en: Preference alignment approaches encourage uncertainty expression or refusal to improve truthfulness, but often consequently degrade helpfulness.
sentences.zh: 偏好对齐方法鼓励表达不确定性或拒绝以提高真实性，但往往因此降低了实用性。

sentences.en: To address this trade-off, existing preference alignment methods typically treat truthfulness and helpfulness as either universally collaborative or universally conflicting objectives across all samples.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一权衡，现有的偏好对齐方法通常将真实性与实用性视为在所有样本上要么普遍协作、要么普遍冲突的目标。

sentences.en: In contrast, we show that these objectives are consistent for most samples and conflict only in a small subset—where adaptive trade-off is truly needed.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们表明，对于大多数样本，这些目标是一致的，仅在少数子集上冲突——而真正需要自适应权衡的正是这些子集。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose Conflict-Aware Adaptive Margin Preference Alignment (CAMP), which explicitly models when conflicts arise and adaptively regulates optimization strength.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出冲突感知自适应边际偏好对齐（CAMP），它显式地建模冲突何时出现，并自适应地调节优化强度。

sentences.en: Experiments on UltraFeedback and representative hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that CAMP consistently improves truthfulness while maintaining a favorable helpfulness trade-off compared to strong hallucination mitigation and multi-objective alignment baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 UltraFeedback 与代表性幻觉基准上的实验表明，与强幻觉缓解与多目标对齐基线相比，CAMP 在保持有利实用性权衡的同时一致地提升了真实性。

title_en: Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance for  Flow Models under Compositional Rewards
title_zh: 组合奖励下流模型的冲突感知加性引导

sentences.en: Inference-time guided sampling steers state-of-the-art diffusion and flow models without fine-tuning by interpreting the generation process as a controllable trajectory.
sentences.zh: 推理时引导采样通过将生成过程解释为可控轨迹，无需微调即可引导最先进的扩散与流模型。

sentences.en: This provides a simple and flexible way to inject external constraints (e.g., cost functions or pre-trained verifiers) for controlled generation.
sentences.zh: 这提供了一种简单而灵活的方式来注入外部约束（例如代价函数或预训练验证器），以实现受控生成。

sentences.en: However, existing methods often fail when composing multiple constraints simultaneously, which leads to deviations from the true data manifold.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在同时组合多个约束时常常失效，导致偏离真实数据流形。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify root causes of this off-manifold drift and find that the approximation error scales severely with gradient misalignment.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别了这种离流形漂移的根本原因，并发现近似误差随梯度错位而严重放大。

sentences.en: Building on these findings, we propose Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance ($g^\text{car}$), a lightweight and learnable method, which actively rectifies off-manifold drift by dynamically detecting and resolving gradient conflicts.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们提出冲突感知加法引导（$g^\text{car}$），一种轻量且可学习的方法，它通过动态检测并解决梯度冲突来主动矫正离流形漂移。

sentences.en: We validate $g^\text{car}$ across diverse domains, ranging from synthetic datasets and image editing to generative decision-making for planning and control.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样领域验证了 $g^\text{car}$，从合成数据集与图像编辑，到用于规划与控制的生成式决策。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that $g^\text{car}$ effectively rectifies off-manifold drift, surpassing baselines in generation fidelity while using light compute.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，$g^\text{car}$ 有效地矫正了离流形漂移，在使用轻量计算的同时，在生成保真度上超越基线。

sentences.zh: 代码可在 . 获取。

title_en: Conflicting Biases at the Edge of Stability: Norm versus Sharpness Regularization
title_zh: 稳定性边缘的冲突偏置：范数正则化与锐度正则化

sentences.en: The remarkable generalization properties of overparameterized networks are often attributed to implicit biases, such as norm minimization at small learning rates and low sharpness in the Edge-of-Stability regime.
sentences.zh: 过参数化网络卓越的泛化性质常被归因于隐式偏差，例如小学习率下的范数最小化与稳定性边缘（Edge-of-Stability）区域中的低锐度。

sentences.en: In this work, we argue that a comprehensive understanding of the generalization performance of gradient descent requires analyzing the interaction between these various forms of implicit regularization.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们认为，对梯度下降泛化性能的全面理解需要分析这些各种形式隐式正则化之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate that the learning rate interpolates between low parameter norm and low sharpness of the trained model.
sentences.zh: 我们在经验上表明，学习率在训练模型的低参数范数与低锐度之间进行插值。

sentences.en: We furthermore prove that neither implicit bias alone minimizes the generalization error for diagonal linear networks trained on a simple regression task.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，在简单回归任务上训练的对角线性网络中，单独任何一种隐式偏差都无法最小化泛化误差。

sentences.en: These findings demonstrate that focusing on a single implicit bias is insufficient to explain good generalization, and they motivate a broader view of implicit regularization that captures the dynamic trade-off between norm and sharpness induced by non-negligible learning rates.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，仅仅关注单一隐式偏差不足以解释良好的泛化，并促使我们以更广阔的视角看待隐式正则化，捕捉由不可忽略的学习率所诱导的范数与锐度之间的动态权衡。

title_en: ConFlux: Multivariate Time Series in Flux, One Unified Forecast in Confluence
title_zh: ConFlux：让变化中的多变量时间序列汇入统一预测

sentences.en: Real-world multivariate time series are inherently in flux: different variables evolve asynchronously and interact in complex, time-varying ways, yet accurate forecasting requires these dispersed signals to converge into a single unified prediction.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的多元时间序列本质上是流动变化的：不同变量异步演化，并以复杂、随时间变化的方式交互，然而准确的预测要求这些分散的信号收敛到一个统一的预测中。

sentences.en: This structural mismatch between dynamic, heterogeneous inputs and a unified forecasting objective poses a fundamental challenge for building general-purpose multivariate forecasting models, especially in zero-shot and large-scale settings.
sentences.zh: 动态、异构输入与统一预测目标之间的这种结构错配，对构建通用多元预测模型构成根本挑战，尤其是在零样本与大规模设定中。

sentences.en: To this end, inspired by the idea that "all rivers run into the sea", we propose ConFlux, a general-purpose foundation model for multivariate time-series forecasting by learning to adaptively integrate cross-channel information under a unified forecasting objective.
sentences.zh: 为此，受“百川归海”这一思想的启发，我们提出 ConFlux，一个通用的多元时间序列预测基础模型，它在统一的预测目标下学习自适应地整合跨通道信息。

sentences.en: Specifically, ConFlux first reorders variables to reduce cross-variable entanglement, then aggregates adjacent variables into compact patches that can be processed by a Vision Transformer-style architecture.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，ConFlux 首先重新排列变量以减少跨变量纠缠，然后将相邻变量聚合为紧凑的块，供 Vision Transformer 风格架构处理。

sentences.en: This design shortens the effective context, reduces attention complexity, and provides a unified token representation for pre-training and downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 这一设计缩短了有效上下文，降低了注意力复杂度，并为预训练与下游任务提供了统一的词元表示。

sentences.en: Experiments on 25 public datasets show that ConFlux achieves state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot, fine-tuning, and from-scratch settings, while offering faster inference and lower memory usage.
sentences.zh: 在 25 个公开数据集上的实验表明，ConFlux 在零样本、微调与从零训练设定中都取得了最先进的性能，同时提供了更快的推理与更低的内存占用。

authors.name: Yuchen Fang
authors.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

title_en: Conformal C2ST: Turning weak classifiers into strong two-sample tests
title_zh: Conformal C2ST：将弱分类器转化为强双样本检验

sentences.en: The two-sample testing problem, a fundamental task in statistics and machine learning, seeks to determine whether two sets of samples, drawn from underlying distributions $p$ and $q$, are in fact identically distributed (i.e.~whether $p=q$).
sentences.zh: 双样本检验问题——统计学与机器学习中的基础任务——旨在确定分别从底层分布 p 与 q 抽取的两组样本是否具有相同的分布（即是否有 p=q）。

sentences.en: A popular and intuitive approach is the classifier two-sample test (C2ST), where a classifier is trained to distinguish between samples from $p$ and $q$.
sentences.zh: 一种流行而直观的方法是分类器双样本检验（C2ST），即训练一个分类器来区分来自 p 与 q 的样本。

sentences.en: Yet despite simplicity of the C2ST, its reliability hinges on access to a near-Bayes-optimal classifier, a requirement that is rarely met and difficult to verify.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管 C2ST 简单，其可靠性依赖于能否访问一个近乎贝叶斯最优的分类器，这是一个很少被满足且难以验证的要求。

sentences.en: This raises a major open question: can a weak classifier still be useful for two-sample testing?
sentences.zh: 这提出了一个重大的开放问题：一个弱分类器对双样本检验仍然有用吗？

sentences.en: We show that the answer is a definitive yes.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，答案是明确的“是”。

sentences.en: Building on the work of Hu & Lei (2024), we analyze two conformal variants of the C2ST that convert the scores from any trained classifier---even if weak, biased, or overfit---into exact, finite-sample p-values.
sentences.zh: 在 Hu & Lei（2024）工作的基础上，我们分析了 C2ST 的两种保形变体，它们将任何训练过的分类器（即使是弱的、有偏差的或过拟合的）的分数转化为精确的有限样本 p 值。

sentences.en: We establish two key theoretical properties of the conformal C2ST: (i) finite-sample Type-I error control, and (ii) non-trivial power that degrades gently in tandem with the error of the trained classifier.
sentences.zh: 我们确立了保形 C2ST 的两个关键理论性质：（i）有限样本第一类错误控制，以及（ii）与训练分类器误差同步温和退化的非平凡功效。

sentences.en: The upshot is that even poorly performing classifiers can yield powerful and reliable two-sample tests.
sentences.zh: 结论是，即使表现不佳的分类器也能产生强大而可靠的双样本检验。

sentences.en: This general framework finds a powerful application in Bayesian inference, particularly for validating Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) models, where the task of comparing a learned posterior approximation $q(\theta \mid y)$ to the true posterior $p(\theta \mid y)$ can be framed as a two-sample test.
sentences.zh: 这一通用框架在贝叶斯推断中找到了强大的应用，尤其是在验证神经后验估计（NPE）模型时，其中将学习到的后验近似 $q(\theta \mid y)$ 与真后验 $p(\theta \mid y)$ 进行比较的任务可以被框定为双样本检验。

sentences.en: Empirically, the Conformal C2ST outperforms classical discriminative tests across a wide range of benchmarks for this task.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，保形 C2ST 在这一任务的广泛基准上优于经典的判别性检验。

sentences.en: Our results establish the conformal C2ST as a practical, theoretically grounded diagnostic tool.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果确立了保形 C2ST 作为实用、有理论依据的诊断工具。

title_en: Conformal Calibration Transfer
title_zh: 共形校准迁移

sentences.en: Conformal prediction converts point predictions into set-valued predictions with coverage guarantees under exchangeability between calibration and deployment data.
sentences.zh: 保形预测在校准数据与部署数据之间的可交换性下，将点预测转化为具有覆盖保证的集合预测。

sentences.en: We study *conformal calibration transfer*, where this requirement fails because labeled calibration is available only in a source space, while prediction sets are needed in a target space linked to the source through *unlabeled paired* observations (e.g., paired modalities or sensor changes).
sentences.zh: 我们研究*保形校准迁移*，此时这一要求失效，因为有标签的校准仅在源空间中可用，而预测集合却需要在通过*无标签配对*观测（例如配对的模态或传感器变化）与源头相连的目标空间中生成。

sentences.en: We propose Transported Conformal Calibration (TCC): we transport labeled source calibration into the target space using the paired data, and then correct residual post-transport mismatch using only unlabeled target inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出迁移式保形校准（TCC）：我们使用配对数据将有标签的源校准输运到目标空间，然后仅使用无标签的目标输入来纠正输运后的残余错配。

sentences.en: We instantiate this correction with two complementary methods: **TCC-KS**, which uses a label-free uncertainty surrogate to detect mismatch and adjust calibration conservatively, and **weighted-TCC**, which reweights transported calibration toward the target domain for improved efficiency when weights are stable.
sentences.zh: 我们用两种互补的方法实例化这一纠正：**TCC-KS**，它使用无标签的不确定性代理来检测错配并保守地调整校准；以及 **weighted-TCC**，当权重稳定时，它将对输运校准重新加权以朝向目标分布，从而改进效率。

sentences.en: We provide finite-sample target-domain coverage guarantees that adapt to an observable measure of mismatch.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了能够适应可观测错配度量的有限样本目标域覆盖保证。

sentences.en: Across CIFAR-100-C, Tiny-ImageNet-C, and SEN12MS, we show reliable target-domain coverage transfer without labeled target calibration data, with label-free diagnostics that predict when correction is needed.
sentences.zh: 在 CIFAR-100-C、Tiny-ImageNet-C 与 SEN12MS 上，我们展示了在无标签目标校准数据的情况下可靠的目标域覆盖迁移，并带有预判何时需要纠正的无标签诊断。

title_en: Conformal Path Reasoning: Trustworthy Knowledge Graph Question Answering via Path-Level Calibration
title_zh: 共形路径推理：通过路径级校准实现可信知识图谱问答

sentences.en: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) offers grounded, interpretable reasoning, but existing methods often fail to provide reliable coverage guarantees over retrieved answers.
sentences.zh: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）提供了扎根的、可解释的推理，但现有方法往往无法为检索到的答案提供可靠的覆盖保证。

sentences.en: While Conformal Prediction (CP) offers a principled framework for producing prediction sets with statistical guarantees, prior conformal KGQA methods suffer from two critical pitfalls: violated coverage guarantees due to invalid calibration, and weak score discriminability that yields excessively large prediction sets.
sentences.zh: 虽然保形预测（CP）为生成具有统计保证的预测集合提供了一个有原则的框架，但先前的保形 KGQA 方法存在两个关键缺陷：因无效校准而违反覆盖保证，以及分数区分性弱导致预测集合过大。

sentences.en: We propose Conformal Path Reasoning (CPR), a novel trustworthy KGQA framework built on two key innovations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出保形路径推理（CPR），一个建立在两项关键创新之上的可信 KGQA 框架。

sentences.en: First, query-level conformal calibration over path-level scores preserves exchangeability to ensure valid coverage guarantees.
sentences.zh: 首先，对路径级分数进行查询级保形校准，保持可交换性以确保有效的覆盖保证。

sentences.en: Second, we introduce the Residual Conformal Value Network (RCVNet), a lightweight module trained via PUCT-guided exploration to learn discriminative path-level nonconformity scores.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入残差保形价值网络（RCVNet），一个通过 PUCT 引导的探索训练的轻量模块，用于学习有判别力的路径级不符合分数。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that CPR significantly improves the Empirical Coverage Rate by 45\% while reducing prediction set size by 52\% on average over conformal baselines across benchmark datasets, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable conformal reasoning over knowledge graphs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在基准数据集上，与保形基线相比，CPR 将经验覆盖率显著提升了 45\%，同时将预测集合大小平均减少了 52%，凸显了其在知识图谱上进行可靠保形推理的有效性。

title_en: Conformal Policy Control
title_zh: 共形策略控制

sentences.en: An agent must try new behaviors to explore and improve.
sentences.zh: 智能体必须尝试新的行为以进行探索与改进。

sentences.en: In high-stakes environments, an agent that violates safety constraints may cause harm and must be taken offline, curtailing any future interaction.
sentences.zh: 在高风险环境中，违反安全约束的智能体可能造成伤害，必须被下线，从而削减任何未来的交互。

sentences.en: Imitating old behavior is safe, but excessive conservatism discourages exploration.
sentences.zh: 模仿旧行为是安全的，但过度保守会抑制探索。

sentences.en: How much behavior change is too much?
sentences.zh: 行为改变多少才算太多？

sentences.en: We show how to use any safe reference policy as a probabilistic regulator for any optimized but untested policy.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了如何使用任何安全参考策略作为任何已优化但未测试策略的概率调节器。

sentences.en: Conformal calibration on data from the safe policy determines how aggressively the new policy can act, while provably enforcing the user's declared risk tolerance.
sentences.zh: 对来自安全策略的数据进行保形校准，决定新策略可以多激进地行动，同时以可证明的方式强制执行用户声明的风险容忍度。

sentences.en: Unlike conservative optimization methods, we do not assume the user has identified the correct model class nor tuned any hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 与保守优化方法不同，我们不假设用户已经识别出正确的模型类型或调优了任何超参数。

sentences.en: Unlike previous conformal methods, our theory provides finite-sample guarantees even for non-monotonic bounded constraint functions.
sentences.zh: 与先前的保形方法不同，我们的理论即使对非单调有界约束函数也提供有限样本保证。

sentences.en: Our experiments on applications ranging from natural language question answering to biomolecular engineering show that safe exploration is not only possible from the first moment of deployment, but can also improve performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在一系列应用（从自然语言问答到生物分子工程）上的实验表明，安全探索不仅从部署的第一个时刻起就是可能的，而且还能提升性能。

title_en: Conformal Prediction for Early Stopping in Mixed Integer Optimization
title_zh: 用于混合整数优化早停的共形预测

sentences.en: Mixed-integer optimization solvers often find optimal solutions early in the search, yet spend the majority of computation time proving optimality.
sentences.zh: 混合整数优化求解器常常在搜索早期就找到最优解，却将大部分计算时间用于证明最优性。

sentences.en: We exploit this by learning when to terminate solvers early on distributions of similar problem instances.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一点，学习在相似问题实例的分布上何时提前终止求解器。

sentences.en: Our method trains a neural network to estimate the true optimality gap from the solver state, then uses conformal prediction to calibrate a stopping threshold with rigorous probabilistic guarantees on solution quality.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法训练一个神经网络从求解器状态估计真实的最优性差距，然后使用保形预测校准一个停止阈值，并对解的质量提供严谨的概率保证。

sentences.en: On six problem families from the Distributional MIPLIB library, our method reduces solve time by over 60% while guaranteeing 0.1%-optimal solutions with 95% probability for new instances drawn from the same distribution.
sentences.zh: 在来自 Distributional MIPLIB 库的六个问题族上，我们的方法将求解时间减少了超过 60%，同时保证对从同一分布抽取的新实例，以 95% 的概率得到 0.1% 近似最优的解。

title_en: Conformal Reliability: A New Evaluation Metric for Conditional Generation
title_zh: 共形可靠性：条件生成的新评估指标

sentences.en: Conditional generative models have recently achieved remarkable success in various applications.
sentences.zh: 条件生成模型近来在各种应用中取得了显著成功。

sentences.en: However, a suitable metric for evaluating the reliability of these models, which takes into account their inherent uncertainty, is still lacking.
sentences.zh: 然而，一种考虑这些模型固有不确定性、用于评估其可靠性的合适指标仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: Existing metrics, which typically assess a single output, may fail to capture the variability or potential risks in generation.
sentences.zh: 现有指标通常评估单一输出，可能无法捕获生成中的变异性或潜在风险。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel evaluation metric called reliability score based on conformal prediction, which measures the worst-case performance within the prediction set at a pre-specified confidence level.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种基于保形预测的新评估指标，称为可靠性分数，它预指定的置信水平下测量预测集合内的最坏情况性能。

sentences.en: However, computing this score is challenging due to the high-dimensional nature of the output space and the nonconvexity of both the metric function and the prediction set.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于输出空间的高维性以及度量函数与预测集合两者的非凸性，计算这一分数颇具挑战。

sentences.en: To efficiently compute this score, we introduce Conformal ReLiability (CReL), a framework that can (i) construct the prediction set with desired coverage; and (ii) accurately optimize the reliability score within the constructed prediction set.
sentences.zh: 为高效计算该分数，我们引入保形可靠性（CReL），一个能够（i）以期望覆盖率构建预测集合；并且（ii）在所构建的预测集合内精确优化可靠性分数的框架。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical results on coverage and demonstrate empirically that our method produces more informative prediction sets than existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了关于覆盖率的理论结果，并在经验上表明，我们的方法比现有方法产生更具信息量的预测集合。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic data and the image-to-text and text-to-image tasks further demonstrate the interpretability of our new metric, and the validity and effectiveness of our computational framework.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据以及图像到文本与文本到图像任务上的实验，进一步证明了我们新指标的可解释性，以及我们计算框架的有效性与效力。

sentences.en: Source code can be found at https://ggc29.github.io/CReL/.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://ggc29.github.io/CReL/ 获取。

authors.name: Yanwei Fu
authors.institution: Fudan university, and Shanghai Innovation Institution

title_en: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee
title_zh: 具有动作条件保证的共形风险厌恶决策

sentences.en: Reliable decision making pipelines powered by machine learning models require uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods that come with explicit safety guarantees.
sentences.zh: 由机器学习模型驱动的可靠决策流水线，需要带有显式安全保证的不确定性量化（UQ）方法。

sentences.en: Conformal prediction provides such UQ by wrapping ML predictions into prediction sets, and recent work by Kiyani et al. (2025b) established that these sets can be translated into optimal risk-averse decision policies -- yet only inheriting marginal safety guarantees.
sentences.zh: 保形预测通过将 ML 预测包装进预测集合来提供此类 UQ，而 Kiyani 等人（2025b）近期的工作确立，这些集合可以被转化为最优的风险厌恶决策策略——但只继承了边际安全保证。

sentences.en: We generalize and strengthen their results by (i) introducing action-conditional conformal prediction, which yields safety guarantees conditioned explicitly on each action taken by the decision maker, (ii) showing that action-conditional prediction sets serve as a proxy for the feasible decision space for risk-averse decision makers aiming to optimize action-conditional value-at-risk, and (iii) proposing a principled finite-sample algorithm based on pinball-loss minimization, connecting the framework of Gibbs et al. (2025) to action-conditional guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们通过如下方式概括并强化了他们的结果：（i）引入动作条件保形预测，它产生显式以决策者所采取的每个动作条件的保证；（ii）表明动作条件预测集合可以作为旨在优化动作条件风险价值（Value-at-Risk）的风险厌恶决策者可行决策空间的代理；以及（iii）提出一种基于弹球损失最小化的有原则的有限样本算法，将 Gibbs 等人（2025）的框架与动作条件保证联系起来。

sentences.en: Experiments on two real-world datasets confirm that our approach significantly improves action-conditional performance over conformal baselines.
sentences.zh: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验证实，与保形基线相比，我们的方法显著提升了动作条件性能。

authors.name: Zihan Zhu
authors.institution: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania

title_en: Conformal Thinking: Risk Control for Reasoning on a Compute Budget
title_zh: 共形思考：计算预算约束下推理的风险控制

sentences.en: Reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs) enable test-time scaling, with dataset-level accuracy improving as the token budget increases, motivating adaptive reasoning---spending tokens when they improve reliability and stopping early when additional computation is unlikely to help.
sentences.zh: 推理型大语言模型（LLM）实现了测试时扩展，随着词元预算增加，数据集级精度随之提高，这促使了自适应推理——在能提升可靠性时投入词元，在额外计算不太可能有帮助时提前停止。

sentences.en: However, setting the token budget, as well as the threshold for adaptive reasoning, is a practical challenge that entails a fundamental risk-accuracy trade-off.
sentences.zh: 然而，设置词元预算以及自适应推理的阈值，是一个实际挑战，它包含一个根本性的风险-精度权衡。

sentences.en: We re-frame the budget setting problem as risk control, limiting the error rate while minimizing compute.
sentences.zh: 我们将预算设置问题重新形式化为风险控制，在最小化计算的同时限制错误率。

sentences.en: Our framework introduces an upper threshold that stops reasoning when the model is confident (risking incorrect output) and a novel parametric \emph{lower} threshold that preemptively stops unsolvable instances (risking premature stoppage).
sentences.zh: 我们的框架引入一个在模型自信时停止推理（冒着输出错误的风险）的上阈值，以及一个新颖的参数化\emph{下}阈值，它抢先停止不可求解的实例（冒着过早停止的风险）。

sentences.en: Given a target risk and a validation set, we use distribution-free risk control to optimally specify these stopping mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 给定目标风险与一个验证集，我们使用无分布的风险控制来最优地指定这些停止机制。

sentences.en: Empirical results across diverse reasoning tasks and models demonstrate the effectiveness of our risk control approach, demonstrating computational efficiency gains from the lower threshold and ensemble stopping mechanisms, all while adhering to the user-specified risk target.
sentences.zh: 跨多样推理任务与模型的实证结果表明了我们风险控制方法的有效性，展示了来自下阈值与集成停止机制的计算效率收益，同时始终满足用户指定的风险目标。

title_en: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling
title_zh: ConFu：考虑未来以改进推测采样

sentences.en: Speculative decoding has emerged as a powerful approach to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference by employing lightweight draft models to propose candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model.
sentences.zh: 推测解码已成为加速大语言模型（LLM）推理的强大方法，它采用轻量级草稿模型提出候选词元，随后由目标模型验证。

sentences.en: The effectiveness of this paradigm critically depends on the quality of the draft model.
sentences.zh: 这一范式的有效性关键地取决于草稿模型的质量。

sentences.en: While recent advances such as the EAGLE series achieve state-of-the-art speedup, existing draft models remain limited by error accumulation: they condition only on the current prefix, causing their predictions to drift from the target model over steps.
sentences.zh: 虽然 EAGLE 系列等近期进展实现了最先进的加速，但现有的草稿模型仍受误差累积的限制：它们只以当前前缀为条件，导致其预测随步骤偏离目标模型。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose ConFu (Contemplate the Future), a novel speculative decoding framework that enables draft models to anticipate the future direction of generation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 ConFu（Contemplate the Future，思前想后），一个新颖的推测解码框架，它使草稿模型能够预见生成的未来方向。

sentences.en: ConFu introduces (i) contemplate tokens and soft prompts that allow the draft model to leverage future-oriented signals from the target model at negligible cost, (ii) a dynamic contemplate token mechanism with MoE to enable context-aware future prediction, and (iii) a training framework with anchor token sampling and future prediction replication that learns robust future prediction.
sentences.zh: ConFu 引入（i）沉思词元与软提示，使草稿模型能够以可忽略的成本利用来自目标模型的面向未来的信号；（ii）一个带 MoE 的动态沉思词元机制，以实现上下文感知的未来预测；以及（iii）一个带锚点词元采样与未来预测复制的训练框架，以学习稳健的未来预测。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that ConFu improves token acceptance rates and generation speed over EAGLE-3 by 8-11%, across various downstream tasks with Llama-3 3B and 8B models.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在不同下游任务上使用 Llama-3 3B 与 8B 模型时，ConFu 相较于 EAGLE-3 将词元接受率与生成速度提升了 8-11%。

sentences.en: We believe our work is the first to bridge speculative decoding with continuous reasoning tokens, offering a new direction for accelerating LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，我们的工作是第一个将推测解码与连续推理词元连接起来的工作，为加速 LLM 推理提供了新方向。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: CONGA:Confidence-and-Gradient-Aware Learning Rate Schedule for Test Time Adaptation
title_zh: CONGA：用于测试时适应的置信度与梯度感知学习率调度

sentences.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pretrained models to test data on-the-fly.
sentences.zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）即时地将预训练模型适配到测试数据。

sentences.en: Current TTA methods have focused on what to adapt: lightweight domain-aware components (prompts, normalization statistics) updated with consistency-aware self-supervised losses.
sentences.zh: 当前的 TTA 方法聚焦于适配什么：用一致性感知的自监督损失更新的轻量级域感知组件（提示、归一化统计量）。

sentences.en: This work investigates the more fundamental yet underexplored optimization process, providing insights and guidelines on how to appropriately update models for TTA.
sentences.zh: 本工作研究更根本但尚未充分探索的优化过程，为如何在 TTA 中恰当地更新模型提供洞.察与指导。

sentences.en: By analyzing the optimization error during TTA, we identify a pivotal stability-plasticity trade-off: the model should adapt to novel distributions while retaining learned knowledge, which motivates our design of a CONfidence-and-Gradient-Aware scheduler (CONGA) to constrain model learning rate (LR)  within an adaptive exploration interval.
sentences.zh: 通过分析 TTA 期间的优化误差，我们识别出一个关键的稳定-可塑权衡：模型应适应新分布，同时保留学到的知识，这促使我们设计了置信度与梯度感知调度器（CONGA），以将模型学习率（LR）约束在一个自适应探索区间内。

sentences.en: For each iteration, the lower bound encourages model exploration on informative confident samples, while the upper bound prevents aggressive overfitting to noisy optimization gradients.
sentences.zh: 对于每次迭代，下界鼓励模型在有信息量的高置信样本上进行探索，而上界防止对含噪优化梯度的激进过拟合。

sentences.en: Based on our theoretical findings, an adaptation-progress-conditioned cosine decay function decides the specific LR within the interval.
sentences.zh: 基于我们的理论发现，一个以适应进度为条件的余弦衰减函数决定区间内的具体 LR。

sentences.en: As an LR scheduler,  CONGA is naturally applicable on existing TTA methods as a plug-in module, introducing little computation overheads.
sentences.zh: 作为一个 LR 调度器，CONGA 可以自然地作为即插即用模块应用于现有 TTA 方法，引入很少的计算开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the superiority and validness of CONGA.
sentences.zh: 大量实验与分析证明了 CONGA 的优越性与有效性。

title_en: Connecting Independently Trained Modes via Layer-Wise Connectivity
title_zh: 通过逐层连通性连接独立训练得到的模式

sentences.en: Empirical studies have shown that continuous low-loss paths can be constructed between independently trained neural network models.
sentences.zh: 实证研究表明，在独立训练的神经网络模型之间可以构建连续的低损失路径。

sentences.en: This phenomenon, known as mode connectivity, refers to the existence of such paths between distinct modes-i.e., well-trained solutions in parameter space.
sentences.zh: 这一被称为模态连接（mode connectivity）的现象，指的是不同模态——即参数空间中训练良好的解——之间存在此类路径。

sentences.en: However, existing empirical methods do not reliably connect independently trained modes and have been evaluated mainly on a narrow set of architectures (e.g., basic CNNs, VGG, and ResNet), leaving their effectiveness on newer models unclear.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的实证方法不能可靠地连接独立训练的模态，并且主要在狭窄的架构集（例如基础 CNN、VGG 与 ResNet）上进行了评估，使其对更新模型的适用性尚不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a new empirical algorithm for connecting independently trained modes that generalizes beyond traditional architectures and supports a broader range of networks, including MobileNet, ShuffleNet, EfficientNet, RegNet, Deep Layer Aggregation (DLA), and Compact Convolutional Transformers (CCT).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种新的、用于连接独立训练模态的实证算法，它超越了传统架构，支持更广泛的网络，包括 MobileNet、ShuffleNet、EfficientNet、RegNet、深度层聚合（DLA）与紧凑卷积 Transformer（CCT）。

sentences.en: In addition to broader applicability, the proposed method yields more consistent connectivity paths across independently trained mode pairs and supports connecting modes obtained with different training hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 除了更广的适用性之外，所提方法在独立训练的模态对之间产生更一致的连接路径，并支持连接用不同训练超参数获得的模态。

authors.name: H Peter Hofstee
authors.institution: Delft University of Technology and IBM

title_en: ConPress: Learning Efficient Reasoning from Multi-Question Contextual Pressure
title_zh: ConPress：从多问题上下文压力中学习高效推理

sentences.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) typically solve reasoning-intensive tasks by generating long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, leading to substantial inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）通常通过生成冗长的思维链（CoT）轨迹来解决推理密集型任务，导致大量推理开销。

sentences.en: We identify a reproducible inference-time phenomenon, termed \textbf{\emph{Self-Compression}}: when multiple independent and answerable questions are presented within a single prompt, the model spontaneously produces shorter reasoning traces for each question.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一个可复现的推理时现象，称为 \textbf{\emph{Self-Compression}}（Self-Compression）：当多个独立且可回答的问题呈现在单一提示中时，模型会对每个问题自发地产生更短的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: This phenomenon arises from \emph{multi-question contextual pressure} during generation and consistently manifests across models and benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这一现象源于生成期间的\emph{multi-question contextual pressure}，并在模型与基准之间一致地显现。

sentences.en: Building on this observation, we propose ConPress
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出 ConPress

sentences.en: (Learning from Contextual Pressure, a lightweight self-supervised fine-tuning approach.
sentences.zh: （从语境压力中学习，一种轻量级的自监督微调方法）。

sentences.en: ConPress constructs multi-question prompts to induce self-compression, samples the resulting model outputs, and parses and filters per-question traces to obtain concise yet correct reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: ConPress 构建多问题提示以诱导自我压缩，采样由此产生的模型输出，并解析与过滤每个问题的轨迹，以获得简洁而正确的推理路径。

sentences.en: These trajectories are directly used for supervised fine-tuning, internalizing compressed reasoning behavior in single-question settings without external teachers, manual pruning, or reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 这些轨迹直接用于监督微调，在单问题设定中将压缩推理行为内化，而无需外部教师、人工剪枝或强化学习。

sentences.en: With only 8k fine-tuning examples, ConPress reduces reasoning token usage by 59\% on MATH500 and 33\% on AIME25, while maintaining competitive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 仅用 8k 个微调示例，ConPress 就在 MATH500 上将推理词元使用量减少了 59\%，在 AIME25 上减少了 33\%，同时保持了有竞争力的精度。

title_en: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures
title_zh: 现代神经架构的守恒律

sentences.en: Understanding gradient descent dynamics is key to explaining the success of over-parameterized models, where implicit bias manifests through conservation laws in gradient flow.
sentences.zh: 理解梯度下降动力学，是解释过参数化模型成功的关键，其中隐式偏差通过梯度流中的守恒律显现。

sentences.en: While such laws are well understood for linear and ReLU networks, they remain largely unexplored for modern architectures.
sentences.zh: 虽然此类定律对线性与 ReLU 网络已被充分理解，但它们对现代架构来说在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: This work develops a unified framework to characterize conservation laws for contemporary models, including feedforward networks with GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU activations, multihead attention with sinusoidal and rotary positional encodings, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures under diverse gating designs.
sentences.zh: 本工作开发了一个统一框架，用于表征当代模型的守恒律，包括带 GELU、SiLU 与 SwiGLU 激活的前馈网络、带正弦与旋转位置编码的多头注意力，以及在不同门控设计下的混合专家架构。

sentences.en: Our theoretical findings are supported by experiments that validate the predicted invariants.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论发现由验证所预测不变量的实验所支撑。

title_en: ConServe: Fine-Grained GPU Harvesting for LLM Online and Offline Co-Serving
title_zh: ConServe：精细利用 GPU 资源，实现大语言模型在线与离线联合服务

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) serving demands low latency and high throughput, but high load variability leads to significant GPU under-utilization.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）服务要求低延迟与高吞吐量，但高的负载波动导致显著的 GPU 利用不足。

sentences.en: In this paper, we identify a synergistic but overlooked opportunity to co-serve latency-critical online requests alongside *latency-tolerant offline* tasks, which existing systems fail to exploit because their coarse-grained resource management introduces interference.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们识别出一个协同但被忽视的机会：将延迟关键的在线请求与*延迟容忍的离线*任务协同服务，而现有系统未能利用这一点，因为其粗粒度的资源管理会引入干扰。

sentences.en: We present ConServe, a co-serving system that enables fine-grained resource sharing through latency-aware token-level scheduling, sub-iteration layer-wise preemption, and incremental KV-cache management.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 ConServe，一个协同服务系统，通过延迟感知的词元级调度、子迭代的逐层抢占与增量式 KV 缓存管理实现细粒度的资源共享。

sentences.en: These mechanisms allow offline execution to fill *millisecond-scale* GPU idle time while preserving strict online latency guarantees.
sentences.zh: 这些机制使离线执行能够填补*毫秒级*的 GPU 空闲时间，同时保持严格的在线延迟保证。

sentences.en: Across real-world workloads with Llama-3.1 and Qwen-2.5 models, ConServe improves throughput by 2.2$\times$ on average and reduces online tail latency by 2.9$\times$ over state-of-the-art systems.
sentences.zh: 在使用 Llama-3.1 与 Qwen-2.5 模型的真实世界工作负载上，与最先进的系统相比，ConServe 将吞吐量平均提升 2.2$\times$，并将在线尾部延迟降低 2.9$\times$。

title_en: Consistency Deep Equilibrium Models
title_zh: 一致性深度平衡模型

sentences.en: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in deep learning, offering the ability to model infinite-depth networks with constant memory usage.
sentences.zh: 深度均衡模型（DEQ）已成为深度学习中的强大范式，能够在恒定内存占用下建模无限深度网络。

sentences.en: However, DEQs incur significant inference latency due to the iterative nature of fixed-point solvers.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于不动点求解器的迭代本质，DEQ 会产生显著的推理延迟。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce the Consistency Deep Equilibrium Model (C-DEQ), a novel framework that leverages consistency distillation to accelerate DEQ inference.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入一致性深度均衡模型（C-DEQ），一个利用一致性蒸馏加速 DEQ 推理的新颖框架。

sentences.en: We cast the DEQ iterative inference process as evolution along a fixed ODE trajectory toward the equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 我们将 DEQ 的迭代推理过程视为沿一条朝向均衡的固定 ODE 轨迹的演化。

sentences.en: Along this trajectory, we train C-DEQs to consistently map intermediate  states directly to the fixed point, enabling few-step inference while preserving the performance of the teacher DEQ.
sentences.zh: 沿这一轨迹，我们训练 C-DEQ 一致地将中间状态直接映射到不动点，从而在保持教师 DEQ 性能的同时实现少步推理。

sentences.en: At the same time, it facilitates multi-step evaluation to flexibly trade computation for performance gains.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它支持多步评估，以灵活地用计算换取性能提升。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across various domain tasks demonstrate that C-DEQs  achieve consistent 2-20$\times$ accuracy improvements over implicit DEQs under the same few-step inference budget.
sentences.zh: 跨各种领域任务的大量实验表明，在相同的少步推理预算下，C-DEQ 相对于隐式 DEQ 实现了一致的 2-20$\times$ 的精度改进。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/landrarwolf/CDEQ}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/landrarwolf/CDEQ} 获取。
